The moment we opened the door, smoke smell welcomed us. The worker there gave us an air refresher to suppress the smoke smell. The place was not very clean, but it was not terrible either.
All the listed amenties were at home. I was provided slippers in any AirBnb I stay, it is like a default, but missing here. The floors are not very clean, so I had to use my shoes even after taking a shower.

-Fully furnished with luxury and new equipments
-Perfectly isolated chat atmosphere
-Cozy and compact space

reviews.text:
Easy to reach area was good but wifi only worked the first day and then stopped and the host was very slow to respond and sometimes didn’t.
The toilet flush also stopped working at times.
Apartment was clean but smaller than the photos show.
Location is very good and close to attractions.

Good points = check in easy, communication decent with quick responses, inside the flat was clean, the amenities are generally good.
Bad points = it’s a basement flat, you are right next to the road and front door as people come and go, the overall feel definitely not ‘luxury’, the WiFi dropped when you were near or on the bed. The duvet was not big enough for two people and was very rough textured and thin (no other blankets and AC controls not present to heat the place.

From booking to checkout Flex was always available over the phone or messages almost instantly.
Very accommodating and helpful.
A true host who is always ready to help his guests , make them feel at home and,comfortable.

Easy to find place.

Ev Resimdeki Görüldüğü gibiydi. Güzel sorunsuz kolay şekilde giriş yaptım. Evin içerisi tertemiz rahat konforluydu. Araç gereç konusunda eksik bir şey yoktu. Perfect location very new building, clean room and very responsive host. Thanks and hope to stay again.

description: Welcome to our Studio Apartment with balcony B on 3rd floor, in Sultanahmet - Istanbul, a charming modern house recently renovated in 2013 and designed for our guests into apartments with modern facilities, nestled in the heart of the old city.

reviews.text: We had trouble finding Saban's place; Google seemed to misdirect us so I'd advise that anyone confirms directions beforehand. The flat was only a short walk away from the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. It was good to be close to these main sites but do be aware that the main areas for going out to eat/drink in Istanbul are not nearby. Unfortunately we found the flat to be less clean and comfortable than the photos suggested. The bed was very uncomfortable, there was peeling paint from water damage near the bed and mould on the bathroom ceiling, and the shower head was broken and could not be used without being held. These are things I could overlook but there were two seriously disappointing issues. First, this listing does not come with parking. There is only street parking available and it is not reliable or safe. The kerbs are too high for a car with low clearance. The only place available to park when we arrived was directly in front of the flat but obstructed in part by a large stone plant pot and small bollards. This meant our car was inevitable slightly sticking out but the person who checked us in advised it would be fine. Unfortunately it wasn't and our car was hit. We were unable to move it until another spot nearby became available on the last day we were there. The second disappointment is that on the second night we stayed the electricity was out from at least the time we arrived back that night at about 10 PM until 3 AM, then again from around 9 AM the next morning. It was still out when we left for the day but was back on that evening when we returned. This meant the AC didn't work, we couldn't use any electronic devices like the hair dryer and we had to shower in the dark as the bathroom had no windows. Apparently electricity outages are not uncommon in this block of flats so be aware. In short, the location is very good if you want to be close to some of the main attractions but the lack of parking, the power outage and the general discomfort made this a disappointing stay.

We stayed at this apartment in early April, and found it very well suited to our needs. The room is clean and warm, with plenty of hot water (just check with Saban how you turn it on), fresh towels, great wifi, comfortable bed, lovely balcony. The kitchen is just sufficient to prepare a basic meal, but some essential items were missing - plugs for the sink and basin, a good sharp knife, a carving board, and a bottle opener/corkscrew (we donated on of these). The location suited us, close to the tourist attractions of Istanbul, but you have a couple of flights of steep stairs from your room to the street, then it's all uphill from there.
We thought that this apartment was good value for money, and a great first experience with air bnb.

Perfectly adequate budget accommodation. Clean with daily housekeeping. Big balcony. Short walk to Sultanahmet square, restaurants and mini markets. Hard bed. Poor check-in. Sent to the wrong address. Was eventually met by a nice young man who brought water and juice and carried my bag up the stairs.

The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures. Keep in mind that it is a 3 story walk-up.

Location:
It is located on a very quiet street in Sultanahmet. The Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia etc. are about 8 minutes walk away. The rental office for the apartment is conveniently located opposite the building next to the Sun Hotel. Incidentally, it is best to give the address of Sun Hotel to the cab drivers.

Service:
* The apartment was cleaned everyday and fresh towels were available daily.
* There was also a hot water kettle with a small selection of tea available in the room.
* WiFi worked as advertised
* No problems with heating or hot showers

Size:
* Ideal for a couple. Plenty of rack space to hang coats and storage space for the luggage

We really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this to anyone.

This place is fantastic! Its a small studio but it has a full working kitchenette, a lovely big balcony and gets a lot of sunlight. It's quite close to the mosque so you do hear the prayer calls throughout the day. Very clean, comfortable mattress, and just the right size for a solo traveler, I would have been happy to stay for a longer stay. The wifi worked well for doing remote work. The walls are a bit thin and you can hear the neighbours in the other unit. The apartment is nearby the main tourist hub of Istanbul and only a few minutes walk to the metro to get to the other areas of the city. The host Saban is lovely, and very helpful and communicative.

description:
This apartment is in central Kadıköy/Moda, constructed according to Earthquake regulations of Eurocode&Turkish Government in 2022. The building is in a safe, silent street, decorated on December 2022.

The building foundation is installed on the rock bottom with deep concrete piles, the structional system also has been chosen, for the possible earthquake wave direction. In conclusion, our building is designed and constructed to withstand any earthquake might occur in İstanbul.

reviews.text: The flat as exactly as described and looks same as in pictures. It was easy to find, very clean. Location is great, with a lot of cafes and small restaurants just around the corner, the sea is max 10 minutes walk. There are several car parkings in case you need one.

This was our second stay with Alper. The apartment and location is unparalleled. Great space, clean, modern and efficient in the coolest of neighborhoods with all amenities and transport nearby. Enough space to make a meal at home but plenty of restaurants and cafes to tempt nearby. The addition of a small desk in the living room was great because it gave us a work space (one of us had to check in with the office - excellent WiFi btw) while leaving the table free for hanging out and dining.
Alper is super responsive to any issues!

Alper is responsive, polite and understanding. The building is located is in a good neighborhood and is very safe. We left a mobile phone inside the elevator for half a day but no one took it away.
The apartment is well designed and furnished efficiently. If something unexpected happens Alper and his team are available to support.
I can’t thank them enough.

Alper's place is exactly what the pictures look like. He is very responsive and helpful. The building is new. The place is not cluttered. I even used the washing machine despite a short stay. Appliances are new. The place gets good light and the bedroom is spacious. The street is safe.

This is a great apartment. Everything was clean and easy to find!
I would recommend adding an extra duvet and pillows for the sofa bed. The sofa bed was quite hard so many even a mattress topper to make it softer.
The bathroom was spotless and we were provided towels and soap. A hairdryer was available too which was great. It was in walking distance to shops, restaurants and bars.
We highly recommend!!!

description:
This flat located in the Beyoglu district is a 10 minute walk to Istiklal Street, the heart and soul of Istanbul's cultural life with many cafes, bars, shops, cinemas and cultural centers.

The flat is found in a historical Greek building. There are three bedrooms and a living room with TV. There are 3 ACs.

reviews.text:
Garen is a great host, always responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with. He also arranged transportation for us to and from the airport, which was very convenient.
The heater worked very well for both room temperature and hot water.
Unfortunately, there were several issues that affected our stay. The building right next to the property is abandoned and appears to be collapsing, which was worrisome. The rooms were much smaller than they appeared in the photos, and the mattresses were extremely uncomfortable.
The bathroom had visible issues: the shower fixtures had bluish moldy residue, and the cabinets showed black mold and water damage. The washing machine smelled very bad and was extremely dirt, I wouldn’t have considered it a usable amenity.
Noise was also a major problem. The upstairs neighbors were very loud at night due to heavy footsteps, and there was no mention in the listing of a body shop directly downstairs that made loud noises while working.
2 out of 5!

Thanks for a great stay. The flat was as shown in the photos and Garen was very helpful. We were 4 people and had adequate space for all of us. We are light sleepers and had to close the windows at night, but otherwise all was good.
The neighbourhood was maybe not the cleanest but we had no problems and felt absolutely safe walking home at night. It’s very central which is great. Definitely good value for money. Thank you.

Good apartment! There are many rooms, and it was comfortable for 4 of us. Very clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Everything needed for a comfortable stay is available. The host was always in touch and helped with all questions, thank you very much! We stayed in winter, and the apartment was very warm ✨
The location is convenient, you can quickly reach Istiklal Street, walk to the old city through the Bosphorus, and get to Taksim Square.
I recommend it! ☺️

We stayed at Garen’s flat for 10 days. The flat is spacious, clean, and reasonably priced for a 3-bedroom in Istanbul. Its location is convenient, just a 10-minute walk to Istiklal Street and close to a bus stop. Garen was also accommodating with an early check-in.
However, the surrounding area feels less tourist-friendly and can be unsettling at night. Some guides mentioned it isn’t considered the safest. Unfortunately, we were without electricity for two full days, which was a significant inconvenience. Additionally, a streetlight shines directly into one of the bedrooms, and the curtains don’t block it well, making it hard to sleep.
While the flat itself is nice and well-located for exploring Istanbul, future guests should consider the neighborhood and comfort issues.

Me and my friends really enjoyed staying at Garen’s place! It looked just like the photos, everything was clean and had all necessities, location wasn’t too far from the center, we found it all in pleasurable walking distance. We had good sleep, thanks to well working AC, we also felt safe in the apartment. Garen himself was very communicative, very helpful and we really felt taken care of. I can’t recommend him enough because it made our trip to Turkey fantastic and left nice memories. :)

description:
Charming and cozy 2-bedroom flat located in the heart of Istanbul, with easy access to some of the city's most popular attractions.The flat is situated right in the middle of Taksim Square and Galata Tower, making it the perfect base for your Istanbul adventure.
Take a stroll down the lively Istiklal Street, explore the historic Galata Tower, or enjoy a traditional Turkish coffee at one of the many cafes in the neighborhood. Whatever your plans, our flat provides the perfect home away from home.

reviews.text: Choosing where to stay in Istanbul can be an overwhelming process. The location of this property is fantastic. It’s a five minute walk to transports heading to both the old town, or towards the Bosphorus and Black Sea areas. The street is nice and quiet for Istanbul and the dwelling is approximately a one minute off a Main Street. The Main Street has great cafes, some shopping facilities and having spent a week in Istanbul, I can say they’re very reasonably priced as well. There are also several bars and clubs all within 15 minutes walking distance and I never once felt unsafe. The apartment itself is tidy and clean with all the amenities one would generally require and, the internet connection worked great. It’s on the third level so those with walking impairments or unfit may struggle getting upstairs. We stayed in early May and the apartment was slightly warm so it could perhaps get quite hot in the summer. I did not know how to use the aircon however I highly recommend booking.

Pros:
Great location for exploring a very interesting part of Istanbul. The apartment has everything you need, and the check-in and check-out process were very easy.
Cons:
The common area (the building entryway) could be cleaned more frequently — during our stay, a noticeable amount of cat waste accumulated there. The stairs are also extremely narrow, which could be challenging even for able-bodied guests.
There was also some confusion about leaving our bags after check-out. The host asked for an additional cash fee, even though we only needed to store our luggage for two extra hours and the cleaning staff had not yet arrived. I left the cash and took a photo as proof, but the host initially claimed the payment hadn’t been made. Thankfully, I had evidence. It may have been an honest misunderstanding, but the extra charge felt unnecessary given that no other guests or staff were affected.

I had a great stay and would absolutely recommend this place. It was clean, modern, and exactly as pictured and described in the listing. The host was extremely responsive, often replying within minutes, and was very accommodating with my requests, which made the stay even smoother.
The only thing worth noting is that the staircase is narrow. It wasn’t a major issue for me, but it may be helpful for future guests to know.
Overall, a very positive experience.

We had 10 daya stay at Yigit’s apartment,it’s an old building that is renovated ,it’s quite not suitable for people with joint pains or elderly people as it has a 4-5 pairs of stairs,location is great walkable to galata tower and taksim square….the only downside is the steep roads,one needs strong legs to climb the steep slopes….beds were not very comfortable…..bed sheets and covers were not washed,they smelled very bad ,they didn’t wash after the previous guests left….on complaining they get them washed….shower in the washroom broke next day which Yigit got repaired instantly…. kitchen was not very clean,dishwasher smelled bad…the oil in the bottle was used and old…spices seemed to be expired….internet got disconnected after 2 days which was fixed after 24 hours.
Overall it was not a nice experience…every other day we have had issues with everything.

The apartment was as exactly as described and pictured. It was comfortable and warm, the shower was excellent, we were able to connect to Netflix. I liked the neighbourhood very much, full of small galleries, antique shops and cafes, also relatively quiet. The host responded quickly to resolve a problem with the boiler. All house instructions were clear and unfussy. In terms of access the road is slippery and waterlogged when there is a lot of rain, and there is a steep spiral staircase to the flat. As regards supplies the host kindly left a bottle of water as we were arriving late. We bought rubbish bags and extra toilet paper and used our own toiletries. I was very pleased I had booked this apartment.

description: Ideal for newcomers to Istanbul or students, our home is a short walk from Marmara University Goztepe Campus and Prof. Dr. Süleyman Yalçın City Hospital. With natural gas heating providing constant hot water, daily life is made more comfortable. Nearby BIM, A101, Selim Hipermarket, Seyhanlar Market, and local shops offer easy access to essentials. Situated in a secure neighborhood with seamless access to public transportation, our home provides a comfortable and convenient living experience.

reviews.text: The apartment is warm and cosy. It is located 5 minutes from local supermarkets, and 10 minutes walk to the main bus line. Likewise, the main train station is 15 minutes away. The apartment has 3 bedrooms, 2 small and one main. Nights were quiet. The kitchen has enough equipment to cook at home, and the TV has access to all main apps. The internet worked well throughout our entire stay, which was important as we were working and taking video calls. Aysun is incredibly helpful with all requests and responsive. Overall, it was an incredibly enjoyable stay.

Orhan was an amazing host. I stayed at this accommodation with my mother. she had the pleasure of meeting him when checking in. Orhan helped her carry our suitcases up 3 flights of stairs. an absolute blessing.
We had a slight problem with the gas but he was so quick to reply to our message to help us.
Anytime we had any questions or contact, he responded almost instantly.
we loved staying in his accommodation, it was clean and the location was fantastic, close to public transport.
the local community were so warm and welcoming to us. If you want to really experience local culture, this airbnb is the perfect spot.
We will definitely be back, absolutely loved everything!!!!

We’ve a great time at Orhans place. He was all the time really attentive and responded very quickly to all our requests. He even made the time to meet us to give us something we forgot at the apartment.
The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. It was very well located for our needs and had a supermarket just across the street.
The only minus point I’d give is that (at least in summer) the apartment is quite hot since there’s no much airflow. The living room and the bigger room are good since there’s AC, but the smaller rooms can get very hot.

Our stay at Orhan's place was wonderful. Orhan was exceptionally friendly and helpful, always very responsive whenever we reached out to him.
The location is incredibly convenient for public transportation—approximately a 20-minute bus ride to Kadiköy. Additionally, there's a 24/7 grocery store right across the street, which was very handy. A 15-20 minute walk brings you to Moda, a vibrant area with numerous breakfast spots, live music at night, and fantastic places for a picnic.
The apartment itself was very clean and had everything we needed. The only minor issue we encountered was the airflow, which was quite static, especially during our stay in June. Initially, we had only one fan for the whole house, but upon informing Orhan, he quickly provided us with another fan, which made a significant difference.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend Orhan's place to others.

Orhan is very helpful and responsive. the apartment is located in a relatively old neighborhood but close to bus stations and 10-15 min ride to the downtown area.
we have every we need and the apartment is clean.

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service, assistance for your concierge needs and dedicated parking space, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text: I have stayed in a few apartments in Istanbul, however I think I have found my new favourite. Apart from having a perfect location, the building is brand new, super modern, and the apartment is stunning. If you appreciate modern architecture, clean lines and a minimalistic feel, but yet very comfortable, then you will love this apartment as much as I did. The WiFi was super fast, and the water pressure in the shower was great. The apartment was on the 1st flr facing the main street, and while the advantage is having the perfect location, you may want to consider one of the apartments not facing the street if you are a light sleeper. The disadvantage is that you can hear street noise. The mobile key access is super cool ! Just be sure that you have access to receive a SMS to the number you provide when booking. I used a local SIM which had a different number, however Gulsah met me at check in and was super helpful and in minutes I had my mobile key. I will definitely be back !

Excellent stay from start to finish. The accommodation was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything needed. The location was convenient and made it easy to explore the area. Communication with the host was smooth and efficient, with clear instructions and a very welcoming approach. Overall, a seamless and enjoyable experience. Would definitely recommend and happily stay again.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Gülşah’s place! From the moment we booked, she was incredibly friendly, easy to communicate with, and always quick to respond to any questions we had.
Her professionalism and warmth truly stood out, making the experience stress-free and enjoyable. We felt so welcome and cared for throughout our visit. The property itself was clean, well-prepared, and exactly as described.
I highly recommend booking with Gülşah if you’re visiting Istanbul, and we will definitely be returning in the future. Thank you again for your kindness and for helping to make our trip so memorable!

One of the best if not the best location/ apartment for the money.
Located right in the heart of Istanbul with lots of restaurants, cafes and shops around.
The design is top notch with everything new and trendy that its one of the few places that looks even better in person.

Mr. Mehmet have been the most wonderful host and helped us with very early check-in and very responsive to any of our needs and concerns
The only downside to this exact unit that you get some noise coming from down the street where the place is facing and if you are noise-sensitive like me that would be a problem
I shared my complaint with Mr.Mehmet and he gracefully accepted to move us to another unit facing away from street.
This a place that I would recommend to anyone without hesitation.
Easy 10\10

The apartment was very nice and matched the description and photos exactly! I had read in previous reviews that the windows weren’t well insulated and that outside noise could be heard — and while that was true, it didn’t bother me personally.
What did affect my stay, however, was the lack of privacy due to the window coverings. The blinds are made of a mesh-like, see-through material, which means that at night, with the lights on, the inside of the apartment is visible from the outside. This is especially noticeable because both the living room and bedroom have floor-to-ceiling windows, and although the apartment is on the first floor, there are stairs directly across the street that look right in.
Additionally, the same blinds let in a lot of sunlight in the morning, making it difficult to sleep during the day or early in the morning, as there’s no way to fully darken the space.
Overall, the apartment was great, but I think the window coverings could definitely be improved for bet

description: The apartment is a 3-minute walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue. The apartment is 38 km from Istanbul Airport and 41 km from Sabiha Gökçen Airport. In line with the requests of our guests, transfer from the airport to the apartment can be made by private vehicle. The apartment is within walking distance to all public transportation. Cleaning can be done during the stay at the request of our guests, but this is paid. The earliest check-in time is 2 pm and the latest check-out time is 12 pm.

reviews.text:
The positive - the host and the communication with him was very good. When lift broke down, they came to help us with carrying suitcases upstairs. If we reported anything, they would come very quickly. They are friendly and lovely. Supermarkets nearby.
The negatives - yes the pictures are of the apartment(s), but the apartments have been worn down a lot since pictures were taken. It’s not deeply cleaned , lots of little red ants and bugs all over. Very dusty and the curtains haven’t been washed for few years as they’re no longer white. Uncomfy beds. The bidet in one of our rooms had low pressure. Very sure there were birds in the ceiling that kept making noises at night.
Out of the host’s control - The view from outside the window is horrible . The roads are steep (mainly are around that area). The mosques outside meant at sunrise you would hear very loud prayers. Taksim is a horrible place for families as a lot of prostitutes are working there.
Would not stay at Taksim again!

We had 2 apartments right across each other in 1 floor. no other apartments on the floor so it felt very private. I travel with my mum and aunt that have knee issues when climbing stairs so having an elevator was a life saver. Loation is excellent, 5 mins from the metro station and Taxim square. (Keep in mind that the road is going upwards when walking to Taxim so it may be tiring for older people).
the apartments looked exaclty like the pictures and communication was excellent.
My only issue was that linen in all beds were not very clean as we found stains in almost all of them.

It was a nice trip for my family and our friends!
Apartments are situated in a small street very near to taxim square.
Neighbourhood looks a little bit scary in the nights, but we was assured it is safe to be there and during our stay we doesn't have any problems.
We was warned by our host to be extremely cautious with our pockets and bags, because there is tiefs on a taksim square.
We arrived by cars - my advice just leave the car in the parking of Taksim Camii - very near and looks to be safe place, and it is even cheaper than parking options in the small streets in the neighborhood. Leave the car there and just walk and use perfect public transports of Istanbul. The apartments have very easy access to few stops thath could bring you everywhere.
The apartments are not very spacy, but they are newly renovated, with comfortable beds and with everything that you may need on a short stay inside.
Chengizgan is very responsive and very supportive,so you can ask him any time for advice

I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this Airbnb. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the entire experience smooth from check-in to check-out. The property was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything needed for a relaxing stay.
The location was convenient, and the attention to detail throughout the home made it feel welcoming and cozy. Communication was excellent, and the host was always available to answer questions or provide helpful recommendations.
Thank you for being such a great host. I would gladly stay here again and recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.
The place was wonderful with a very good location 2-3 minute walk to taksim square, clean, and looks like the pictures

description: You’ll love the stylish decor of this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: It was a clean appart hotel room with a kitchenette. We stayed only 2 nights. Walking distance to Ortakoy, where there are lots of shops, restaurants and cafes at the seaside.

Konum çok merkeziydi ve ulaşım kolaydı.
Gayet temiz konforlu ve rahat bir deneyim yaşadım

Çok rahat ve huzurlu biyer, İstanbul trafiğine karışmadan İstanbul’un merkezinde,ayrıca tertemizdi, banyosuna çıplak ayak basabildiğim,deliksiz 9 saat uyuyabildiğim bir otel,umarım fiyatlarınız hep makul olur. sonraki seyahatimde tekrar konaklamak istediğim müthiş otel… Tüm personele teşekkürler diliyorum. Birde pati dostu olmanız da harika 🙏🏼

We had a really good stay here. The apartments are very clean, comfortable and well maintained. The staff are super nice, friendly and always ready to help. I also really appreciated having a 24-hour reception — it makes everything much easier, and there is always someone there if you need anything.
Overall, everything was great and we felt very comfortable during our stay. The only downside I would mention is the soundproofing between the apartments — you can hear the neighbors quite well sometimes. Apart from that, everything was perfect and I would definitely recommend this place.

I loved this Place peaceful safe area nice garden
Osman on the reception welcomed us warmly a helpful respectful man

description: Our hotel is in a convenient location for shopping and close to historical places with its newly restored luxury rooms.

reviews.text: Great place as described, pictures were accurate. Communication was excellent and very helpful. One mattress was slightly dirty.
Very close to Taksim, on quite a steep street but totally value for money, very responsive host and clean and spacious place

Ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi ve her soruma kısa sürede olumlu şekilde döndü. Ev lokasyon vs Herşey çok güzeldi. Eksik olarak bir kaç mobilya da sigara yanığı ve teras taki masa kırıktı. La casa corrisponde abbastanza alle foto, per le quali però è stato probabilmente usato un grandangolo. Poiché l'appartamento è in un residence ed è probabilmente gestito da una società e non da un privato, l'atmosfera della casa è prevedibilmente anonima, senza alcuna concessione al "calore domestico". Anche le attrezzature rispecchiano questa impostazione, c'è unicamente lo stretto necessario: non una seggiola nelle camere, un unico phon per 3 bagni, non un coltello seghettato per il pane, non un appendino/gancio nelle camere o nei bagni, non una insalatiera o zuppiera, scarsissima dotazione di cucina. Nihan, la co-host, è stata in compenso molto gentile, disponibile e reattiva.
It was the right place for our trip. Great Customer service, our host was always available to help with anything regarding the property. Overall a pleasant stay 😊.

description:
From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a whole group. reviews.text:
We had a very good experience staying at Serdar’s apartment in Istanbul. He was a kind and responsive host, and even helped us with our luggage, which was much appreciated as the apartment is on the second floor.
The apartment was very clean and well located—close to many of Istanbul’s main sights, with plenty of nearby restaurants and local supermarkets for essentials. We mainly used the apartment in the evenings as we were out exploring during the day, and it was a comfortable place to return to.
The second bedroom didn’t have air conditioning, but Serdar provided a fan, which was sufficient for our needs. The bathroom was a little dated, and the shower head could benefit from easier adjustment, but these were minor issues and didn’t affect our overall enjoyment.
There was a bit of traffic noise outside at times, but that’s probably just me being picky. Overall, a great stay and a very convenient base for seeing the city. Thank you, Serdar!

The apartment is well located for sightseeing, and we enjoyed the restaurant downstairs. The apartment is spacious for two people and the beds are extremely comfortable. Our host and associates were welcoming and responsive.
Unfortunately we were disappointed by the level of road noise, which isn't of course the fault of the host. Airbnb listings provide a general indication of location, which gave us the impression that the apartment would be further down a quiet lane rather than on the corner of a busy road.
The place was clean and as described. lcated in a great area near touristic and historic places and markets

reviews.text: This is a wonderful apartment. It is located close to the embankment. Fatih was always in touch and helped even late at night. It was not easy to find parking, but the hotel security told me where to go to get to the apartment parking.

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment was spotless, beautifully furnished, and had a lovely view. The air conditioning worked perfectly, which made a huge difference, and the location was incredibly convenient—Ubers arrived within a minute every time.
While I wouldn't particularly recommend the food at the Radisson itself, that's hardly an issue because the fantastic Fişekhane outdoor shopping and dining district is just a short walk away. It's a vibrant, stylish area with excellent restaurants, cafés, and a great atmosphere.
A special thank you to Fatih, who was an exceptional host. He was incredibly responsive, friendly, and always willing to help, making the entire stay smooth and enjoyable. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

This is my second time staying here, and once again it was a great experience. The place is clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Fatih and his crew are incredibly kind, welcoming, and always quick to respond whenever you need anything. They made us feel right at home. I will definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a wonderful stay.

"The place was beautiful and fantastic, very close to all public transportation and offering a lovely sea view. The apartment was clean and well-organized. The only issue was with the heating system."
Clean and perfect place

description: Discover Istanbul from our stylish, spacious retreat in the heart of the historical peninsula! Perfect for large groups and families, this modern apartment comfortably accommodates your party. Enjoy fast fiber internet and a prime location just a 2-minute walk from the Blue Mosque and 5 minutes from Hagia Sophia. Your ideal base for exploring the city's iconic landmarks.

reviews.text:
I cannot emphasise enough how wonderful this place was. The home was immaculately clean from the moment we entered. The floors were spotless and shiny, the beds were fresh and comfortable, and the shower was beautifully lit and very clean. It was clear that the host puts a lot of effort into maintaining the property, and cleanliness is truly a priority.
The house was very comfortable for our family of six. The WiFi was excellent, and the TV was great too; the kids really enjoyed watching YouTube on it. The host was extremely kind, helpful, and considerate. He helped us with parking, gave us great restaurant recommendations, and even allowed us to check out three hours later than the original checkout time. He always responded within minutes, which gave me so much peace of mind as a first-time traveler to Turkey.
This place is a blind pick in the best way. It is spotless, comfortable, family-friendly, and the host is genuinely kind. You can trust booking it.

Finding a comfortable place for a big family in Istanbul is not easy, but we were lucky to find this apartment! It has three proper bedrooms with double beds and a shared living room where we could gather in the evenings. The two bathrooms are a huge bonus. The host was very responsive. The location is central, with shops, restaurants, sights, and a tram stop nearby. New furniture, well-equipped - everything matched the photos, and the mattresses were perfectly firm for a good night’s sleep. The apartment was warm even during a cold, windy week, thanks to underfloor heating. Great stay!

Location deserves 5 stars, it was very close to all the tourist attractions in the old town. The host was very responsive when things needed attention.
The apartment itself is spacious and the living space was comfortable and had adequate seating. However, it needed more attention. It was not clean upon our arrival. The linens were not very clean either. The small half bath was unusually odiferous. The dishware and glassware were not clean but the dishwasher was not working so we had to wash dishes by hand until the issue was corrected. Later during our stay we were without hot water and heating for 1 full day. The host is very friendly and did his best to correct the issues timely, but nevertheless, all these problems detracted from our experience. Some extra attention to maintenance of the apartment would help make it shine like the gem it could be.

He is very responsive and easy going.
the house is clean and as described in the photos. 2-3 min walk to the tramway. Me and My family had a good time there. The area is also safe.

This AirBnB apartment is clean as shown in the advertised pictures. The host Emre is very responsive and friendly. The location is excellent. My family and I have been staying here for 6 days and will be happy to come back one day in the future.

description:
This unique place is located in Polat Piyalepaşa Residence, close to Taksim and Nişantaşı by car. It is located in a living complex with many amenities available for your access. There is a mall in the complex which includes a Pharmacy, Supermarket, Hairdresser, Restaurants and etc. Inside the apartment there is a fully equipped kitchen, free wifi, underfloor heating, air conditioning, smart TV and etc. Also has a 24/7 security.

YOU CAN USE FREE SHUTTLE TO TAKSIM SQUARE

reviews.text: Thank you Adam! Amazing listing, just like in the photos. The hair dryer wasn’t working, Adam replaced it straight away. The bed sheets were clean and there were spares as well. Just like in a hotel. The kitchen has everything to make any meal. And the location is peaceful, and only a 25 minute walk from Taksim. The complex itself is safe with many restaurants and shops. Highly recommended!

If i could give this more stars i would - from the second i booked Adam was incredibly helpful to the point he was up at 2am helping me get into the apartment when my place was delayed, being a solo traveller this was so gratefully appreciated.
The space was clean and had everything you need.
The location was epic with coffee / supplies & food right downstairs.
I always felt safe and secure.
HIGHLY recommend 10/10

I had a great stay in Istanbul! The host was very kind, guided me well throughout my trip, and always stayed in touch to make sure everything was fine. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had all the basic essentials I needed. A very convenient and pleasant experience overall – highly recommended!
Adam and Oktay were very helpful and the apartment was great. Very clean and perfect location.

Loved the space and apartment complex - well supplied with good transport links to central Istanbul. Plenty of shops and supermarkets downstairs. It felt very safe and secure. Check in was excellent and the host was very responsive. Would definitely stay again!

description:
This elegant apartment is located in a flat and easily accessible area, just a 5-minute walk from Taksim Metro Station. Located in the heart of Cihangir, the house is just a few steps away from popular cafes, restaurants and supermarkets.
🔸 Kitchenette and basic cooking utensils.
🔸 Wi-Fi, TV, Netflix

reviews.text: First of all, I loved the neighbourhood. It had everything I needed -- including a million cats--and it was so walkable and convenient to get to coffee shops, restaurants (I'm vegan), grocery stores, the ferry, the streetcars, Tophane, Karikoy. I stayed for two weeks and Gizem's apartment in really felt like home. Everything was clean, fresh and new; the space was cozy but not too small, and it was always quiet at night. My only complaint is the wifi -- it only works at one end of the house and isn't the strongest. I had to use my data in the bedroom.

Amazing spot to stay in Cihangir. 10-15 mins walking to all fun things in Beyoglu and public transportation. Super walkable and tons to do. Place is as described and Ali Bey was super responsive and helpful with any of our needs.

Location wise perfect if you are city travelling but size-wise not so much. I would say big enough for two people but not more. Comfortable bed so you are certain to have a good nights rest.
It’s walking distance from many sightseeing spots. A lot cafes around. Paid car parking very close by if you are travelling by car. Free to park on the road if you are prepared to drive around till you find an empty spot and walk a little.

Gizem’s apartment was fantastic, very clean, quiet, well furnished and everything I needed for a wonderful time in Istanbul, I highly recommend, exactly what I was looking for in my accommodation in a super lovely neighborhood. I’m so glad I stayed at her place :) you will enjoy it too!

Well located. Relatively calm, couldn't hear any noise from the bedroom.
The only inconvenience is the weak cigarette smell, which is ubiquitous in Istanbul and is in the room as well. it's either from previous travelers or neighbors, more likely both.

description:
We have other 1 bedroom and 2 bedroom apartments available for our guests. All our apartments have a high review score.

Enjoy a cosy and stylish experience in this centrally located apartment. Our apartment is just 100 meters away from Istiklal Street. Our apartment is on the third floor, there are no lifts in the building.

reviews.text:
Ibrahim is one of the best hosts I've ever encountered: very organized, responsive, and friendly. He let us check in early at no extra cost and even left some snacks and water for us, which was a lovely touch.
The apartment is great and has everything you might need for a comfortable stay. The location is excellent, with plenty of restaurants nearby. Istiklal Street is only a 5-minute walk away, Tophane tram station is about 10 minutes on foot, and Kabataş ferry terminal is just two tram stops away.
Just a small heads-up: there is no elevator in the building, so keep that in mind if you're traveling with heavy luggage.
Overall, I would highly recommend staying here!

I really recommend this place. The host is very responsive and friendly. Instructions were clear. Place was exactly as described and looked like the photos. The place is right by the İstiklal avenue which is one of the most touristic and central part of Istanbul. Metro stations is within walking distance and overall is super accessible.
The only cons would be that this specific unit is on the 3rd floor and is a bit hard to climb the stairs especially with luggage, and one more would be that it’s a very loud neighborhood due to a church being right by the apartment and the nature of the neighborhood that’s very touristic. Sometimes you could hear loud noises and people outside dancing and partying all the way till morning. But I was aware of these cons so I didn’t have much of a problem with them.
I appreciate the host for everything and really enjoyed my stay here.

I had an amazing week-long stay at this apartment near Taksim Square. The location is perfect - just a short walk to Istiklal Street, great restaurants, shops, and public transport, yet the apartment itself is cozy and comfortable. Everything was exactly as described, very clean, and well-maintained.
The host was exceptional: friendly, responsive, and always ready to help with questions. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and the communication was excellent throughout the stay.
Overall, a great place to stay in the heart of Istanbul. I would recommend it to anyone visiting the city!

Ibrahim’s place is just one street away from Taksim’s main tourist area, so the location is excellent with plenty of shops, restaurants, and attractions nearby.
The apartment looked exactly like the pictures and felt like home right away. Ibrahim was very thoughtful and even provided us with a baby bed and baby bath, which was perfect for our stay. We always had warm water to take a shower ! The AC worked well. There was a super big TV where you could watch Netflix, Disney+, etc. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily recommend it ! 5🌟
(As in many parts of Istanbul, there are some stairs to reach the main streets. The apartment is located on a street with stairs — not a problem for most people, but we had a baby stroller so it was a bit more of a challenge)

I very much enjoyed staying at this Airbnb for five days. It was extremely clean, well located, and the host was very responsive and had a house manual. What matters in these Airbnb’s are the little touches and he had provided milk, pasta, and water which was super helpful as well as spice and oil. It made the stay very comfortable. The AC works well and the wifi is very fast. I would stay here again thank you Ibrahim!

description: Experience the charm of historic Balat in this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath flat, nestled in one of Istanbul’s most colorful and culturally rich neighborhoods. Enjoy a private terrace w/ views of Balat’s iconic rooftops and Saviour de Chore. Steps away from the famous Fener Greek Patriarchate, Iron Church, and vibrant Kiremit Street; this home is surrounded by cozy cafés, antique shops, and art-filled alleys—perfect for travelers seeking comfort, character, and authentic local life.

reviews.text:
Overall: 3 stars. Clean flat, excellent host, but oversold and not for anyone with mobility limits.
Most important: the stairs are steep, no elevator, three flights to the top. I fell and was bruised and in pain for over a week. The stairwell smells musty, and of garbage on bin days. If anyone has mobility issues, skip this one.
The hosts were a real bright spot...responsive and helpful throughout. The flat is clean and the living/kitchen space matches the photos, though the kitchen is darker in person.
The terrace is oversold: small, dried-out plants, covered in bird droppings. Balat is interesting and gets much nicer two minutes down the street, but right here it's loud ...seagulls day and night, late street noise, and five nearby mosques on loudspeakers from 4:30am to 11:30pm. Taxi access is poor: steep, uneven incline and narrow streets, drivers won't reach the door.
Price was fair, but it's listed 5-star and isn't. Fine as a thrifty, characterful base if you're able-bodied.

It was truly a wonderful stay. The place exceeded all our expectations – it was extremely clean and comfortable. The host was very welcoming and attentive, which made our experience even better. We are very thankful for everything and would highly recommend this place

Highly recommend, for long stay too!
We stayed for a month, and It was the best accomodation, that we would dream. Everything that we could think was in the apparrment. Nice view, so quite neighbors, for Istanbul and cute community in the area and perfect location - so authentic and kind
We walked around every day and got really much pleasure
Our host was the best
So if you are doubt between some variants no doubt

Neighborhood is very friendly and expect to make friends.
Would return to this apartment 100%

reviews.text:
Ilkan and team were super friendly and responsive to all my queries. The place is clean, easy to use, and centrally located.
The wifi was good enough to work from and the host was accommodating to re-setting the router when needed.
The noise coming down the street was a little loud at night but nothing ear plugs can't solve.
thank you for a wonderful stay.

Hiçbir iletişim, erişim sorunu yaşanmadı. Ev vadedilen tüm olanaklara sahipti. Konumu iyiydi, ulaşım seçenekleri çesitliydi. Yüksek tavanlı eski bir daire. Bakımlı ve temizdi. The Mayer Team was exceptionally responsive every time I had a question or needed something. Their attentiveness made me feel welcome during my stay at this Airbnb. The location is ideal, in Beyoglu neighborhood - where you can walk everywhere and you’re close to public transportation.
The only thing I wish they paid more attention to was the bedding and linens. It needed more pillows, plush comforter and a firmer support mattress. I could not sleep well most nights.
Beyond that, I recommend this place if you ever find your in the beautiful city of Istanbul.

Loved the apartment, comfy and exactly as described. Bed (always a dealbreaker if not good) was excellent. The location in Galata is really great, because while the area around Galata Tower is very touristy, the apartment is located in a quiet street.
Great service too, very proactive during our stay. Also on our departure day we could leave our bags at their office (which is just around the corner) as our flight was in the evening.

We are not the type to complain and the place was okay enough but we felt with just a little bit of effort, it could have been better. Walking in, we were disappointed right away; the place didn’t have the same look and feel of the photos, it was the worn down, aged version. There were things listed in the listing that were not actually there (shampoo, bath soap, hand soap, dishwasher, lock box), and even though we didn’t necessarily need those items (except the shampoo and soaps) they shouldn’t list those items if they don’t actually provide them. The bedding was perhaps the most frustrating part of our stay, as the sheet over the mattress didn’t quite fit and constantly came undone, bunched up under us when sleeping, and we had to retuck it every night before bed hoping for the best, but it resulted in poor sleep quality. One window was broken, not properly closing so we had extra street noise on top of the other noise. Out of space herebut could list more,attention to details needed

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Clean and comfortable, place as described. We had a great time here!
konum olarak Kadıköy ün ortasında işlek bir sokak. ev temizdi tuvalet kağıdından şampuana kadar tüm ürünler bulunuyordu. ev sahibi her konuda anlayışlıydı
Excellent host; responsive and supportive. The property is located in a vibrant neighborhood featuring many restaurants and interesting walking streets, all within a short distance of the ferry.

If you are doing a long weekend or short break in Istanbul on the Asian side, I cannot recommend Kadikoy and Ugur's apartment particularly.
Everything is walkable. Including an array of amazing restaurants and bars, the metro station, the ferry port and the football stadium if you a ground hopper!
Ugur was very friendly, with nice clear instructions and brilliant local recommendations. You can walk around Kadikoy's packed lanes for hours each day and keep finding something new.
The only thing I would say is, Not suitable for anyone who struggles with stairs, as you need to negotiate 4 flights with no lift, but that wasn't an issue for me and my party.

A wonderful place to stay in a lively neighborhood! Perfect for large groups, just like ours. Everyone had their own private space. We were able to check in early and check out a little later, for which we are very grateful. I highly recommend it!

description: Our hotel is on the tramline, 10 steps away from the Sultanahmet tram station and 1-5 minutes walking distance to all historical sites. From our terrace, you can see the Sultanahmet Mosque, the Sea of Marmara, the Princes' Islands and the Sultanahmet Square. Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapı Museum, Grand Bazaar are 2-5 minutes on foot

reviews.text:
The location is extraordinary: just a 5-minute walk to the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, and about 10 minutes to Topkapi Palace.
Kerem and his staff were very kind and attentive during the stay.
The room has a very nice view, although it is on the third floor with no elevator.
The value for money is good, but don’t expect a luxury room.
Overall, it is recommended mainly for its location, perfect for those who want to be very close to the most representative and historic landmarks of Istanbul.

This hotel is in the best location in Istanbul. I could see the blue mosque from my bedroom. Sophia, the palace, and many attractions right around the corner. Food everywhere! And it is right on the tram line. It was very clean and safe. I would stay here again on my next trip. Thank you for a wonderful trip 🙏🏼

Nos encantó, solo a unos pasos de los lugares más turísticos, lo único “malo” es que no entran vehículos por lo que hay que salir a otras calles para tomar taxis o Uber, sin embargo el hotel tiene una excelente ubicación, muchos centros de comida cerca , farmacias, etc nos encantó!
El cuarto tiene lo necesario
Great location with amazing view, would gladly come back
Todo muy bien

description: The apartment is located in the lively, historical and touristic Kadıköy Bazaar area. It is close to Kadıköy Coast, Fenerbahçe Stadium and many entertainment venues, bars, restaurants, Kadıköy fishermen's bazaar, performance stages and theater show centers. Since our apartment is located in the center of Kadıköy, it is within walking distance to all public transportation. I recommend that you make a reservation knowing that it is a 35-40 year old building and that there may be noise from the bars around and below it.

reviews.text:
We had a really great stay in the apartment. Check-in was very easy, communication with the host was smooth, and the area is just great, with plenty of pubs and restaurants to go nearby, so I'd definitely recommend that!
A couple of things to be aware of: the street is quite busy, so it may not be ideal for very light sleepers. Also, due to smoking in the area and the pub downstairs, there was sometimes a noticeable cigarette smell in the apartment in the evenings.
Overall, we had a very nice stay. It offers great value for the price, and we would definitely recommend the area to others.

-Evin anahtarında “yedek” yazıyordu kopyası olması normaldir, ama banyo kilitlenmiyordu, yalnızdım ve duş alırken rahat hissetmedim
- Verilen daire (No 3) yangın merdivenine giden çıkışı kapatarak oluşturdukları bir yerdi. Tavanda sabit, ledli yangın çıkış tabelaları perde önünde de merdiven vardı. Hem illegal hem tehlikeli
-Asansör yok karşılama yok anahtar dairenin kapısına takılı. Valizle zor. Ev de görünenden daha eski.
-Sonradan öğrendim ki binanın tamamı bu kişiye ait ve hepsi airbnb’de kiralanıyor. Ancak girişte kaç kişisiniz, kimsiniz, dürüstçe isimleri girdiniz mi diye kontrol edilmiyor. Kimin girip çıktığının belli olmadığı 8 dairelik bina, ciddi bir güvenlik sorunu.
- Oda söz verilenden 25 dk geç hazırlandı kapıda bekledim ok ama defalarca “beklerken alt kattaki işletmemde %15 indirimli yemek yiyin” dedi. Her işletmenize para kazandırmak zorunda değiliz
- Mecburi bir durumdan uzatma istediğimde anında airbnbden fiyatı yükseltip ibana yönlendirdi,direkt çıkışımı yaptım.

Öncelikle yorumlara bakarak bunu yanıtlıyorum. Mutfaktan veya banyodan çok koku geliyordu duramıyorduk oturamıyorduk diyenler için bilgilendirme yapmak istiyorum. Kış ayındayız ve deniz seviyesinde bir konaklama yapıyoruz. Hava ne kadar eser ve lodos olursa haliyle koku daire içine girebiliyor. Bu da belli bir saat içersinde oluyor devamlı değil. Kadıköy’de bir dairede de otursanız aynı şeyi yaşarsınız. Yani bu konaklama yapılan yerle ilgili bir durum değil. Bunun bilincinde olalım. Bunun dışında oturma grubu, televizyon, mutfak, bazı araç gereçler, yatak odası, duş ve duş ürünleri, her şey titizlikle düşünülmüş. Fiyatı da gayet uygun. Güvenilir de bir yer. Alt katında bulunan bar restoran işletmecisinin yeri zaten bu daireler. Herhangi bir sorununuzda hemen yardımcı oluyorlar. Her saatte telefonla da ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Ben çok memnun kaldım. Kadıköy konaklamamda vazgeçilmez dairem olacak. Her şey için teşekkürler.

Dairenin konumu çok iyidi. Ev sahibinin de açıklamada belirttiği gibi dairenin ve binanın eskiliğinden dolayı birkaç zorluk yaşadım tavan badanası eskidiği için birkaç kere kireç dökülmesi oldu. Onun dışında banyo giderleri tıkalı idi duş alırken 5 dakika içerisinde zeminde su seviyesi yükselmeye başlıyordu banyo deneyimi için iyi şeyler söyleyemem pek.
Yine de herkesin tercihi farklıdır benim için konum daha önemliydi konumu muhteşemdi ev sahibi ilgiliydi
Konum kolay bulundu kimse ile iletişime geçmeden eve giriş çıkış sağladık rahattı konum olarak harika biyerdeydi

description:
A few minutes' walk from the famous Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue. It is also located in the Cihangir area, where there are original cafes. The restaurant is in the center of shopping and history
There are two of these quiet and peaceful apartments. You can have a pleasant stay in one of the available apartments :) If you cannot find a suitable date for accommodation, you can write to me for the other apartment, I will be happy to help :)

reviews.text:
Airbnb review
I had a great stay at Ruken’s place! Everything was very clean and comfortable, and the location was perfect ,close to everything and just a short distance from Taksim. Ruken was also super responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout my stay. I really appreciated it and would definitely recommend staying here!

If you’re just staying a couple of days, this place will do the job. But if you’re even remotely a light sleeper, don’t book it. The building sits right next to a hospital, so ambulances roll in at night, sirens, random alarms. I wouldn’t call myself sensitive to noise, but even I was waking up multiple times a night, and it definitely affected my overall stay in Istanbul.
The apartment itself is… fine for the price. No major complaints on that front. But let’s be honest: the photos are clearly outdated. In reality, it looks worn out. Peeling paint, loose outlets hanging off the wall, a plastic window that doesn’t fully close, so the street noise comes through as if it’s open. Same issue makes it pretty cold at night too.
The bed is uncomfortable and squeaks with every move, which doesn’t help the whole sleep situation.
So yeah. For a short stay, you can probably tolerate it. But anything longer, and this place will start getting on your nerves fast.
Great location, very close to the main street Taksim, good price and clean apartment. ☺️

I stayed at Ruken’s place in Taksim for a week and overall had a very good experience. The room was extremely clean and Ruken was warm, friendly, and very responsive — she provided everything I needed in a short time. The only small drawbacks were the lack of a wardrobe in the room, the slight downhill walk from Taksim, and the fact that the apartment is next to a school, which can be noisy on weekday mornings if you’re a light sleeper. Apart from that, everything was great. I’m between 4 and 5 stars, but honestly closer to 5 because of the excellent hospitality.
Konaklama sorunsuz ve keyifli geçti. Ev temiz, düzenli ve ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey mevcuttu. Ev sahibinin ilgisi ve iletişimi için teşekkür ederiz. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim

description:

Staying here means you and your family will be close to everything the historic center has to offer.

reviews.text: This place is a haven in istanbul. near to all visiting places. the house itself is exactly as shown in photos. Zeki is a very wonderful host. he went above and beyond for our comfortable stay. place feels like home. Furniture and bedding is clean and new. kitchen is full of all things you need. we cooked home food. i recommend this place to stay. thank you zeki.

Zeki was responsive and very hospitable, the location is great if you are intending to explore Fatih, with local food and recommendations around the area. Only a 10minute walk to Hagia Sophia, and a 25minute walk to the Bosphorus straits. Rooms were comfortable and spacious, a little hiccup with the hot water but host was around to help fix when needed. Overall a good location and a comfortable stay with a responsive and helpful host.

Zeki’s place is perfect for launching any adventure in Istanbul. Its proximity to all the key sites made it perfect for walking. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and Zeki is the consummate host willing to do anything to make his guests comfortable.

Flat as described, great location within easy walking distance to Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and tram to waterfront. Good restaurants nearby too.
Zeki kindly organised our transport to/from airport and met us at apartment which was great,
Really clean house with the perfect location. Host is very kind and let you feel comfortable while you stay.

description:
The apartment is located in the Akbatı Shopping Center. 100 Mbps fiber internet, hot and cold water, a double bed , a single bed and a sofa bed are available. It is equipped with 50-inch Android TV, kettle, tea maker, basic tools for cooking, oven/cooker, microwave, refrigerator, hair dryer, washing machine, dishwasher, clothes iron.

There are 2 separate bedrooms, 3 beds and 1 sofa.

Ideal for long-term stays. See you!

reviews.text: The flat is in a good location with a lots of restaurants and shops. Our stay was okay apart from having issues with entering the court as there are barriers and security who didn’t allow us to get inside the parking lot without permission, which of course we had to ask the owner for. And this is every time we tried to get back. Which is very annoying and wasting our time. The security people don’t speak English and that makes it difficult. Another issue was the smell in the kitchen coming out from the sink. It’s disgusting and very annoying during the stay, especially when having a dinner. The host wasn’t very responding to cooperation and trying to make his point on things that didn’t work really. The mattress in the bedroom needs replacing as it’s gone completely, the bathroom has stains and broken cupboards, missing parts and etc. A bit disappointing. Easy access though, and nice area. Feels overpriced for what you get.

Not a luxury apartment as described
Not bad , although not expensive but still not the greatest value for money as the home needs alot of work to be called “luxury”

We enjoyed our stay. Perfect location with restaurants and supermarkets in the surrounding area. The apartment was exactly as in the pictures. We were 4 people and Emre provided another bed instead of someone sleeping on the couch.
Definitely will stay again.

2 gece kaldık hiç bir problem yaşamadık, site giriş çıkışındada sıkıntı olmadı ev sahibi kolaylıkla otoparka girmemizi sağladı. Evde temiz düzenli ve yeterliydi. Birdahaki geldiğimizde müsaitlik olursa tekrar kalacağımız bir ev oldu bizim için

description:
This room, which is within walking distance to popular areas and metro bus stops in the center of Istanbul, is suitable for long and short-term stays, and we always have an open garden.
Access information is automatically displayed in the arrival information 48 hours before the reservation, and everything is as specified in the system.

reviews.text: Unfortunately, our stay was disappointing. The bed sheets were dirty, and the apartment did not feel very clean overall. The garden was also not well maintained. Before booking, make sure to double check the location, as it does not accurately match the listing. The host was very slow to respond, which made communication difficult. The only positive aspect is that the property is close to the main attractions.

I had a wonderful stay Mehmet’s place! The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, clean, quiet, and very well organized. The location is perfect for tourists, just near Refik Saydam and within walking distance to Şişhane Metro, making it super easy to access all the main attractions in Istanbul.
Mehmet was very cooperative and an excellent communicator. I requested to extend my stay by one more day, and he made the process smooth and hassle free. I really appreciated his support and hospitality.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Istanbul

The location was hard to find, we tried to communicate with the host and he never replied to us. After we found the place on our own (bc the hotel doesn’t exist in google maps for some reason), we checked in on our own and we found the room. The room didn’t have a normal window, the tv wasn’t working ( or the remote, we don’t know ) and one of the bed lights wasn’t working either. The shower door was missing and overall the room was small with natural light missing. The breakfast actually is a scam, cause it only had eggs and tahini. Last but not least bc the days we visited it was raining the breakfast/ garden was wet (even the food was wet). Thank god we stayed only one night!
Bedsheets was stained and the toilet roof also. Photos don't match with reality. Left the room immediately and didt get the money returned. Location is good btw.
Definitely a little simpler and older than in the photos, but definitely recommended for the price. The location is great

description: In the center of Taksim, within a 3-minute walking distance to all public transportation. Completely renovated historical building… a small apartment but with all the amenities and comfortable.. 5 min walking distance to Taksim Square in the most central part of Istanbul..

reviews.text:
I had a very comfortable stay at Emre's place. I was communicating with his co-worker Feyza who was 10/10 with communicating and so friendly, so thank you very much to you Feyza!
I found the place was cozy and comfortable, perfect for a city break. A few mins walk from Taksim square and public transport.
I also want to add that I work online the internet strength was very good, I was able to do video calls no problem.
Would happily stay here again!

Perfect location for exploring Istanbul, just a couple blocks from Taksim Square and a metro station. The apartment is charming and on the top floor and is full of natural light. Just be prepared to walk up a few flights of stairs. Emre was an extremely communicative and friendly host.

I stayed for a week at this place and, tbh, great location and very close to Taksim. Location-wise, ideal. The house is exactly like the pictures, and Emre was very responsive and helpful. I had a great time at this place. Will stay again if I’m in Istanbul

Stayed for a week in Emre’s place located right next to Taksim. A great location being close walking distance to restaurant, bars and shopping. The area is always busy so felt pretty safe walking back in the evenings. Emre was very responsive and helpful during my stay.
great communication, amazing location, thanks so much!

description:
Welcome to a 120-year-old historic home tucked away in one of Istanbul’s most iconic neighborhoods — Galata.
Lovingly designed with a funky and warm interior, this charming space is the perfect mix of old soul and modern comfort.

Located just steps behind the Galata Tower, you’ll be within walking distance to İstiklal, Galataport, the metro, tram, and Cihangir. It’s ideal for travelers who want to explore the heart of the city while staying in a truly special place.

reviews.text: Fabulous place! Super chic and comfortable pied a terre in beautiful neighbourhood. Suheyla was a wonderful host - kind, helpful and super responsive. Location could not be better. Clean place. Comfortable bed. Lovely shower. We’ll definitely be back. Thank you Suheyla!

Ev sahibi ile iletişim çok iyiydi. Eve giriş çıkış kolaydı, konum da harikaydı. Tıpkı fotoğraflardaki gibi özenli dekore edilmişti.Salonda ısıtma çok yetersizdi. Akşam özellikle o kadar soğuktu ki oturması biraz zordu. Hatta yemek yerken masayı koridora doğru taşımamız gerekti çünkü pencerelerden inanılmaz yoğun bir hava akımı geliyordu. Yatak odasında ısıtma iyiydi gece bir sorun yaşamadık. Mutfak ekipmanları bence yetersizdi. Özellikle kahve makinası olmalıydı diye düşünüyorum en azından basic bir filtre kahve makinası ya da soda/meşrubat açacağı.
Great place — exactly as described. Comfortable, clean, and in a very convenient location for walking around and exploring the area. Would happily stay again.

I stayed at Suheyla’s apartemnt for 6 nights, and I have no words to describe what wonderful experience it was. Check-in was super easy. I was shocked when I found out how close to Galata Tower it was and how accessible it was for use to try the best San Sebastian dessert 😅 Suheyla responded very fast and even solved us a problem we had in a very short time, which was wonderful. The tram station (T1), which most of you will need to take when visiting Istanbul, was a short walk away and there’s also the bus station if you go to other directions which made us very easy to travel through city. Also the Karakoy port was very near and made it able for us to visit Uskudar, Kadikoy ect. I have to say that for me it was a wonderful experience exploring Istanbul and staying at Suheyla’s place was an added value for sure

Süheyla’s apartment is in a wonderful location and exactly as shown in the photos...beautifully decorated and very well maintained. Süheyla is an exceptionally kind and attentive host, always available to answer questions and provide helpful recommendations. I truly appreciated her hospitality and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommended.

description: Welcome to our bright and modern 1+1 terrace apartment with a direct view of St. Anthony of Padua Church, located just 1 minute from Istiklal Avenue, right in the heart of Beyoğlu. With its central location, walking-distance access to major attractions, and fully equipped interior, this home is ideal for both short and long stays. A perfect choice for guests seeking comfort, scenery, and unbeatable accessibility in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Pretty cute little apartment in a very artistic neighbourhood in Istanbul. The balcony is the highlight and is very nice for grabbing some fresh air during the hot summer days.
On the other hand, the cleanliness is not the highlight of the apartment. It is not the worst either. You can sense that the furniture and carpet are a bit dusty.
Unfortunately, the water boiler didn't work at the beginning. But the host was responsive and fixed it in the end.

Konum İstiklal Caddesi’nin dibinde. Şişhane metroya 5 dk. Fotoğraf ile aynıydı daire. Biz çatı katını tercih ettik. Yalnız bina yıllanmış olduğu için merdivenler ince ve dönemeçli ona göre göz önünde bulundurun. O da tahminim gibi eski bina sonuçta. Gerçekten temiz ve havadardı. Birkaç bir şey istedik ve hemen yardımcı olundu.

A great place to stay in Istanbul!! Easy to access a ton of touristy things but also felt a little more private since down an alley. Super awesome. The only thing to mention was the walk up since we were on the top floor - a lot of semi scary steps in the old building. otherwise incredible just important if accessible is an issue. A kind and flexible host who was very responsive and helpful with anything we needed. I plan on returning!!

Konumu çok iyiydi; merkezi olmasına rağmen oldukça sessiz bir yerdeydi. Giriş süreci son derece kolaydı ve ev sahibiyle iletişim hızlı ve sorunsuzdu.
Yatak çok rahattı ve genel olarak konaklamamdan keyif aldım. Daire çatı katında olduğu için bazı noktalarda tavan biraz alçaktı, ancak bunun karşılığında manzarası gerçekten etkileyiciydi. Asansör olmaması nedeniyle üst kata çıkmak zaman zaman zorlayıcı olabiliyor, fakat bu durum deneyimimi olumsuz etkilemedi.
Genel olarak çok memnun kaldım ve gelecekteki seyahatlerimde tekrar tercih etmek isteyeceğim bir yer.

description: Experience the vibrant heart of Istanbul at our cozy apartment hotel, perfectly nestled just 150 meters from the iconic Taksim Square! Our soacious room is designed for comfort and convenience, featuring a fully-equipped kitchen with all the essentials, so you can cook up a storm. Enjoy a relaxing stay with us and explore the city's best spots, all within walking distance. Book now and make yourself at home!"

Merkezi bir konumda olması , giriş-çıkış rahatlığıyla gayet güzeldi. Teşekkürler

reviews.text:
Firat’s flat was absolutely the right choice for our stay in Beyoğlu. The room was very nice—comfortable, clean, and spacious—with beautiful high ceilings that made it feel even more airy and inviting.
The location is fantastic—surrounded by countless restaurants and bars.
The people in the area are incredibly friendly, especially our downstairs neighbor who runs an authentic Turkish kebab restaurant. The staff there were super warm and welcoming—we loved it!
A special thanks to our co-host Ömer, who was very responsive and kind throughout our stay. He even arranged airport transportation for us for our 2am departure, which we truly appreciated. We’re very grateful for such professional service. The flat is within walking distance to the metro, the Tünel station, and most importantly, lively and crowded Istiklal Avenue. This was the best location we’ve stayed in so far in Istanbul—and this was already our second trip to Turkey!
We highly recommend it

Overall, I had a good stay. The host was very responsive.
The location is excellent — right between Galata and Istiklal, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and shops nearby. It’s a lively area, and the street below is known for music instrument shops.
The apartment itself is clean and tidy. The hot water and heating work very well, which made the stay comfortable. it’s a great place.

The flat is clean and tidy, with everything you need. The location is amazing, right in the heart of Istanbul. All the main attractions are within walking distance, as are delicious local restaurants and shopping. I stayed at Firat’s and Ömer’s for four days with my mother, and she was thrilled.
Ömer and Firat are great hosts. They are super friendly and helpful. They truly understand their guests' needs and are always ready to help.

The apartment is beautiful and the location is central. The host is very proactive and was always checking in if everything was okay or if we needed anything. The only thing to note is the noise, due to the central location (above restaurants and bars) it is very loud at night.

Ev konum olarak İstiklal caddesindeydi her yere çok yakın çok iyi bir konumdaydı, bir çok yere yürüyerek ulaşım sağladık. Ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi, ev temizdi biz sadece gece yatmak için kullandık.
