description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service and assistance for your concierge needs, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text:
The host was very friendly and helpful and even drove out to meet us to retrieve our keys, which we really appreciated. This was because the apartment had a leak and the plumbers needed access while we were away. The location is great and very walkable. We stayed in apartment #5, which is at the top and requires walking up a long circular staircase.
That said, the apartment was not quite as accurately represented in the listing as we expected. We had no water for a little while and afterwards there was no hot water for some time. We also ran out of toilet paper, and some of the floorboards were broken. Overall, the apartment could use some repairs and maintenance. The location and helpfulness of the host were definitely positives, but the condition of the apartment could be improved.

the flat itself is located in the best area in istanbul, very close to the galata tower, twenty minute walk to galata port and kabatas ferry station if you want to travel to the asia side or to the princess islands, ten minute walk to cihangir, surrounded by very cosy cafes and trendy restaurants. the perfect location.
however, the flat itself is a serious danger hazard. the floor boards are broken and cave in on you when you are walking, especially if you are walking fast, you can easily twist or break a leg, it almost felt as if we were on a boat. it did not feel safe at all.
also, the cleanliness of the flat was terrible. there was dust everywhere, behind the sofa and bed, underneath the kitchen and bathroom cabinets, on the window panes. you can visibly the bathroom floor hasn’t been washed in years, coming out of the shower, we still had dirty feet. it’s very evident the only cleaning they do after guests is wash the bedsheets and towels.

Really great stay. Situated in the heart of the city but in tucked away in the quieter corner of the neighbourhood, so we got the best of both worlds. The flat was very clean and the listed amenities were all available to use. The only thing to look out for is that the building doesn’t have a lift and you need to walk a few flights of stairs, so it isn’t the most accessible accommodation. Aside from that, our stay was wonderful thanks to the hosts and a great location for us first-time visitors to Istanbul who wanted to be close to the action but still be in a peaceful and safe neighbourhood.

The place has the potential to be 10/10 unfortunately there’s been some flaws:
- rotten oranges in the kitchen
- overall the place felt clean but nonetheless some not so obvious parts have been dusty
- the faucet in the bathroom was super shaky and I’ve almost burned myself as it set itself to hot water which was set to 55deg
- the curtains didn’t block enough light / in the living room provide little privacy
The good:
- lovely windows and views on almost all sides, view to church and galata tower
- great charm and wooden floor (one part was broken although)
- new pants in kitchen and salt and oil (bad that’s also been it what it’d want to use / has been there)
Overall it’d book again, but only for the price I’ve paid or a bit less

We liked the accommodation. On the downside, we noticed dust and dirty windows, as well as very old dishes and cutlery. Also, the boiler in the living room is noisy, which might disturb some people’s sleep, and in the bedroom, there’s a draft from the window, making it cold at night. Other than that, I recommend this apartment — it’s bright and pleasant, and the location is good.

description: Spacious 2+1 apartment in the heart of Cihangir, 3 minutes from Galataport and 10 minutes from Taksim. This newly renovated apartment with modern touches offers a comfortable stay with its sea view living room, usable kitchen and high-speed internet. The bohemian streets, cafes and restaurants of historic Beyoğlu are located nearby. Close to the tram, metro and public transport. Due to its location, you have to climb a short slope, but the view is well worth this short walk.

reviews.text: Kötü bir airbnb deneyimi yaşadığım günün ertesinde bu evi tuttum ve temizlik konusunda hassas olduğumu dile getirdim. İlyas Bey en hızlı şekilde ve tertemiz bir konaklama imkanı sundu. Kendisine ne kadar teşekkür etsem az. Banyo, yataklar, mobilyalar vs. hepsi son derece temizdi. Adres çok merkezi bir konumda ve her yere yürüme mesafesinde. Apartman sessiz ve güvenilir. Tekrar ziyaret etmeyi ve burada konaklamayı sabırsızlıkla bekliyorum.
İlyas bey çok ilgili bir ev sahibi,evin konumu çok iyi ve güzel bir manzaraya sahip,bu fiyata kalınabilecek en büyük dairelerden birisi
clean and close to Galataport and many tourist attractions, and the host is friendly and helpful.
kendi evimizde gibi hissettik gayet temiz konumu da iyi

I had an amazing stay at Ilyas’s place. It was really easy to get into the centre of the city and the area around the apartment is great (bring good shoes though as it’s hilly!). Really helpful with checkin and check out and the place was really spacious and had amazing light and a great view. Thanks so much!

description: My apartment, located in one of the most valuable apartment buildings in Galata, has a usable area of 120 m2 and an incredible view of the Bosphorus. With its 2 bedrooms, spacious living room, bathroom and kitchen, it meets all the needs of large families. Wi-Fi and Smart TV are available in both the living room and the bedroom. It is very close to many transportation points, and you can easily reach Istanbul's most beautiful tourist attractions on foot. Renovation work has been done on the exterior of our building. There is no elevator.

reviews.text: I usually like staying in an apartment that makes me feel like home and this place did exactly that. The apartment building is a bit rundown but once inside it's exactly as pictured, spacious, with lots of light and the view is spectacular. The bathroom is a bit older with less lighting and a not a big shower but the rest of the space compensates for it. Nice and quiet bedrooms. The curtains are not super dark though, although I like some light in the morning, however if you need a very dark room, perhaps get something to cover your eyes. One thing... this is 5 floors with no elevator, which was fine by me, and once you see the view you totally forget about it (happened to my aunt), yet if someone has issues with their knees or heavy luggage, it's something to consider. The neighborhood is fantastic; totally walkable, with great restaurants, boutiques and conveniently located. Faruk was helpful, attentive & easy to reach. Highly recommended!

The apartment is located in such a great area. It felt safe and was close to the bridge for if you want to walk over to the Hagia Sophia, blue mosque, etc and just minutes from galata tower. Amazing neighborhood with great cafes, restaurants and night life. Also a grocery store right around the corner if you need anything. The place was pretty large and comfortable. The hosts were very nice and helpful! I would 100% stay here again if I’m ever back in Istanbul. Just be prepared that you do have to walk up a few flights of stairs to get to the apartment. It wasn’t a problem for us, but just if you have bags you are unable to carry or something. Amazing place though, definitely stay here!!!

This flat was in a great location, near the Galata Tower, close to the Galata Bridge. It is on the 6th floor, which requires climbing a lot of stairs, but has great views and it is really quiet. The layout of the floor plan is spacious and the two bedrooms are separated by a long hallway so there is a lot of privacy. It has great sitting areas with gear views and a well stocked kitchen.

This is a great area to stay in. Near restaurants and bars and all of the major sites. Plus amazing views over the Bosphorus which were unrivalled.
Faruk was so helpful and responsive. He helped to organise lifts to and from the airport and checked in with us during our stay to ensure we had everything we needed.
Great location with a beautiful view of the Bosphorus. We really enjoyed our stay. Just keep in mind that there is no lift, which can be a bit challenging if you have a lot of luggage.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family.

reviews.text: 14-16 Ağustos tarihlerinde konaklamamızı gerçekleştirdik. Rezervasyon süresinde ev sahibimiz hızlı bir şekilde iletişime geçti. Kaldığımız yerin lokasyonu çok iyiydi. Zaman zaman da pencereleri açarak havalandırdık. Biz hiç kullanmasak da mutfakta kısmında kullanıma yönelik mikro dalga, kettle gibi eşyalar vardı. Biz konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Temiz güvenilir ve konum olarak harika fırsatlar sunan bi yerdi teşekkür ederiz

description:
Enjoy a simple and cozy stay in this centrally located, stylishly designed duplex, which is for your exclusive use in this quiet area.

Walking distance to Nişantaş, Beşiktaş Ferry Pier, Kabataş Tram Station, Maçka Park, Beşiktaş Bazaar , Akaretler Town Houses. Close to Taksim Square-Istiklal Street , Harbiye, Osmanbey Metro station.

There are a lot of cafes-restaurants nearby, it is one of the special neighborhoods of Istanbul.

reviews.text:

The check-in process was very easy and convenient. We were able to self-check in without any issues, and the instructions provided were clear and helpful.
We especially enjoyed the terrace. It was a wonderful place to have a coffee in the morning, enjoy the fresh air, and simply relax after a day of exploring the city. It added a special touch to our stay.
One of the things we appreciated most was the location. Although there are many restaurants, cafés, shops, and other amenities nearby, the neighborhood itself is surprisingly quiet and peaceful. It offers the perfect balance between convenience and relaxation.
In the evenings, it was lovely to take a walk around the area and enjoy the atmosphere. Having so many places within walking distance was definitely a great bonus.

We had a good stay at this lovely, duplex apartment just a few minutes' walk up from the Besiktas boat landing, surrounded by cafes and restaurants in a very lively neighborhood with everything at hand. We had a pleasant stay. The apartment was very clean and well maintained, and communication with the host was easy and prompt. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We enjoyed our time here and would consider staying again if we're back in the area.

description: Welcome to our modern 1-bedroom apartment in the heart of Sultanahmet, Istanbul's historic center. Located just 1 minute from Hagia Sophia and only a short walk from the Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, and the T1 tram station, you'll be perfectly positioned to explore the city's most famous attractions.

reviews.text: The place looked exactly like the photos. The view of the Hagia Sophia was exactly as described literally opened the balcony door and boom there it was. The bed was large and comfortable and the bathroom had plenty of room with an absolutely amazing shower good water pressure, hot water, and a good size. You’re 5 minutes walk from Hagia Sophia and Topaki Palace while being 10-12 minutes walk from the Grand Bazaar and 15-20 from the spice bazaar. It’s in a nice part of old town not quite too busy and close enough to transportation that it’s easy to catch a tram to the ferry to get around. Loved the place and would absolutely go back again.
Great location and amazing hospitality. Highly recommend.

description: 3BR Flat with sea view and just a minute away from Galata Tower. This means a lot about central and colorful&live neighborhood with many transportation options. The building is historical and more than 125 years old with amazing redbrick walls and architecture. You will enjoy a lot with your friends/love/family at rooftop with spectacular view. The apartment is on the 3rd floor. There is no elevator in building.

reviews.text:
I was honored to be the first guest at Furkan's amazing apartment. He was a wonderful host. He answered all of my questions that I had before booking quickly, he checked in multiple times before I arrived, and he made sure throughout my trip that I had everything I needed.
I travel often to Istanbul and this apartment is by far the best I have stayed. The apartment is exactly like the pictures. It is an authentic building with amazing exposed brick. Many places I have stayed are a disappointment in person but this apartment is incredibly clean, beautifully decorated and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. The view is amazing!
As I had to work when I am in Istanbul, strong wifi is critical and I never once had a connection issue running multiple devices. The shower is hot and great water pressure. The bed is comfortable as is the lounge area. Even the extra touches like a backgammon set made this stay so special.
You are in an authentic building by Galata. There will be some noise and of course a hill. However it is easy to get to the tram or metro and if you don't want to walk up the hill you can take the tunnel at karakoy and walk down. This apartment is so centrally located to everything.
Thank you Furkan for an amazing stay. This will be the only apartment for me on my upcoming trips!

The property looks as described and is in a very walkable area.
Pros:
-There is a fun rooftop with patio tables shared by the building and you can watch photo shoots on the rooftop next to you.
-Walkable but be prepared for a lot of hills.
-Very busy area and felt safe.
- Ferkan is very responsive and did set up our transfer from airport.
-Spacious living room great views.
Cons:
-Main issue was unpredictable hot water for showers. It is a building issue not unit issue. But if you try to shower from 7a-10a it is almost guaranteed there will not be hot water. We started rotating showers and usually late afternoon or evening hot water was available. It was a big inconvenience.
-Everything smelled like smoke - towels and bedding. Not sure if it is a unit or building issue. We sprayed fabreze to help but the scent was definitely present.
-very little place for belongings - no dressers or shelves. Just stand alone hanger rack.

(TLDR: Highly recommend if looking to stay in Galata area)
Spacious apartment w/ great view that matches the photos. We (2) stayed a full week in Dec and the apartment met our needs perfectly.
We had hot water regardless of when we showered day/night. Beds were fantastic. Heating units & Wifi worked perfectly & we had no noise issues. Even on the weekends it got quiet by midnight.
Conveniently located near many restaurants, a grocery store & public transportation. (Note that the tram is at the bottom of the hill & there are a few flights of stairs up to the apt but unavoidable for this area & also what makes for such great views!)
We had no issues with Ubers reaching the entrance despite some narrow roads, but we only chose to use a cab from/to the airport - otherwise, there’s no need!
Furkan was responsive to our questions & provides maps/guidebooks in the apartment’s “reading nook.”
Small suggestion would be to add some shelves in the bathrooms for toiletries.
Thanks Furkan!

Furkan was super responsive. Check-In was a breeze and the apartment was exactly as advertised on airbnb. Everything was clean and all the necessary essentials such as shower gel etc. was provided.
The Location couldn't be better, just next to the Galata tower. The view from the terrace overlooking the bosphorus was breathtaking.
Furkan was an exceptional host, providing us with great tipps for shopping, dining, sightseeing and so on.
I'm convinced this place is the best value for money you can find in all istanbul. Highly recommended! I will be back for sure.

I stayed at Furkan's place with my two friends and from start to finish the experience was amazing!
Furkan was able to provide us with airport transfer - we were picked up just when we arrived and dropped back to the airport in plenty of time for our flight. This made check-in and check out a breeze.
When we arrived, the place was exactly as advertised/pictured. The roof terrace, sitting room, and main bedroom had the most fantastic views. The beds in both rooms were incredibly comfortable (honestly it's a wonder we were able to get up and enjoy Istanbul at all - and that saying something considering how amazing the city is!). The bathroom was spotless and the shower was lovely, water was hot at all times and the pressure was great too. Essentials were provided and plentiful. The kitchen was fit for purpose. Furkan was kind enough to have a bottle of wine chilling for us and also provided bottled water and some snacks.
The location of Furkan's place was ideal for our trip. Situated in a very cool less touristy area within walking distance of some really trendy restaurants, bars and of course the beautiful Galata tower which guided us home each night. It was a great base for exploring Istanbul and despite the fantastic location, it was very quiet allowing for a great sleep after long days spent adventuring in the city.
Furkan was readily available throughout our stay with tips and communication was a breeze. We are looking forward to returning to Istanbul and Furkan's place will be at the top of our list when we do and in the meantime, we will be recommending him to all of our friends and family. Thanks a million once again Furkan for everything!

description:
COMFORTABLE ACCOMMODATION, CENTRAL LOCATION, AND ONLY 10–12 MINUTES FROM THE AIRPORT

Our new hotel, located in the city center, offers a comfortable stay with its luxurious, modern and hygienic rooms. Restaurant and cafe services are available. Our rooms have air conditioning, a 42-inch TV, tea, coffee, and water.
We offer 24/7 reception, free WiFi, paid airport transfer, quiet rooms, and early check-in/late check-out.

Dear guests, we hope you have a pleasant and comfortable stay.”

reviews.text: Great place to stay. It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was welcoming and responsive, and the location near the airport was very convenient. Highly recommended.

The apartment was clean and exactly as shown in the photos. The location was easy to find, and the neighborhood was lively and convenient. The host was very helpful and responsive throughout my stay. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it.

The staff was very nice, friendly and profesional. Easy check in. Communication with the host spot on. The room was simple but clean and looked after, the same as discribed on the pictures. Definitly recommend!
Very nice hotel, conveniently located near to the airport. Offers airport transfer as well which makes things easier.
It was a pleasent stay for 1 night near the airport, place was clean and pretty much great overall. Room is a bit small but its very practical for a stay near the airport

description:
Our apartment, which is only a 1-minute walk from Galata Tower, is located in a historic building that has survived from 1906 to the present day. With its high ceilings, original architectural details and spacious atmosphere, it offers modern comfort while keeping the spirit of old Istanbul alive. Being on the ground floor provides easy access with suitcases. You can enjoy the breathtaking panoramic view of the Galata Tower, the Golden Horn and the Bosphorus from the common terrace.

-Şişhane metro station is 3 minutes away
-5 minutes to Karaköy Tram
-5 minutes to Karaköy ferry

reviews.text:
The location alone is worth it!! A couple of streets away from Galata Tower & in a very happening area. The rooftop view is breathtaking too & was a treat both in the morning & at night.
Not to take anything away from the apartment itself which was exactly as in the pictures, very tidy & comfortable. Loved the vibe of the old building with a tasteful renovation. Can’t fault it for anything really.
Finally, the hosts were very responsive & helpful too. Waited for us till midnight for the personal check-in and also let us keep our bags at the place post check-out as we had some time before heading to the airport. Would 100% stay here on my next trip as well :) Thank you!!

We had a lovely stay at this charming home in Beyoğlu. It is very well-located, spacious, welcoming, clean and matches the description and photos. The views from the rooftop are breathtaking. The hosts were great, very responsive and helpful throughout our stay even giving us amazing recommendations for Istanbul. We will definitely stay there again when in the city.

3 nights here was not enough! Beautiful personalized super comfortable bed. GREAT location 2 blocks from T2 tram, bottom to top of hill. Quiet apartment. Good sleep. Well equipped. Safe secure private. So many Airbnbs are now IKEA knock offs. Not this. Great to be in a hand crafted home. Located at beginning of Istiklal central Beyoğlu. Shops cafes architecture delights. Ground floor an added plus. My only complaint is that we should have stayed longer. But we will return. HIGHEST RECOMMENDATIONS. Communications were immediate. The pictures and descriptions are accurate but don’t capture the emotional excitement of the area nor the fascinating discovery of the apartment. The hosts are personable. Great views from huge rooftop. Better than Galata Tower. Can’t wait to come back. Thanks for hosting us. Your place is remarkable.

The apartment has a very nice location, just a 5-minute walk from Galata Tower and only a 7-minute walk from the metro. It’s on the ground floor with no stairs, which is very convenient. The apartment was also very clean and comfortable, with two bedrooms and a small bathroom. The service was very good, and overall, we had a great experience.

Great location and very convenient for getting around the city. The place was clean and comfortable. It can be a little noisy at night because it’s in a busy, touristic area, but overall we really enjoyed our stay. The host was very kind and helpful. Thank you!

walking distance to the famous istikal street. A great place to stay for a family. Host made us feel so welcomed. Amenities were clean & comfortable 😍 Definitely a thumbs up & rated 5 stars! Will go back here on our next trip!

Lovely spacious apartment in a very nice, quiet, secure complex. Pool is wonderful and great for swimming laps. The apartment is very well equipped, great balcony, furniture and beds are excellent. description: The house is very close to the center of Istanbul. It has a sea view and parking area. This house can be used for at least 1 months up to 3 years at most. It is prepared for the guests. The home decor is modern and useful. There are TV in the living room and in the bedroom, air conditioner in the bedroom, also a private bathroom in the bedroom, a bathtub and hot water a butcher, a stationery and a greengrocer in the same street with house. The center is a 5-minute drive away and a 15-minute walk

reviews.text: The apart is on the 4th floor. The stairs are wide but there is no elevator in the building. The residential area is great. There is a bazaar on Tuesdays. You can find any fresh fruits, vegetables and fishes in here. There is a market stationery and grocery store near the house. Their employees are very helpful people. The house is within walking distance to the Kulaksız bus stop. There is parking area in the building. The house was really nicely furnished, especially the bed was very comfortable. There are 2 bathrooms. There is a bed in the children's room. The internet connection is working fine. Most importantly, it has a quiet and incredibly beautiful sea view. You can see many historical places from here. Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque and Fatih Mosque are right in front of you. We usually wrote a message to Ilhan and he booked us a taxi to the door. If you definitely come once again, this will be your choice again.

Ilhan was an amazing host. Very responsive, polite, and friendly.
The place has a beautiful view, is very spacious, and well equipped. The furniture is clean, theres extra bedsheets and blankets, and the kitchen is equipped with everything you could need to cook. This place is excellent and the location is really good too, its close to the market and a short walk to bus and taxi stops which are also really close to the main tourist locations one might want to visit. Highly recommend staying here! Perfect for long stays.

we will be in this place for 2 months. it has a good place for seeing the golden horn waterway in nice view but this appartment having some issue and some problem for improvement. the issue is the appartment located in 4th floor by climbing 68 stair to get into the appartment believe me its make you as fat burning.also the internet speed and wifi was poor. other big issue are the aircondition its I think out of colling gas. for summeryou are in sauna. in good fact I can say the neighborhood was good to accessing almost for everything but the house are in top of month of kasimpaşa. its helping for fat burning too.the host was good and helpful.i had surgery in istanbul during my vacation and it made me pain and but. becoI hade climbing 68 stairs when I hade go out. in general it's not ok for old people. by the way if improving some issue it will be ok place in Istanbul trade area.

I spent an excellent July here. Had breakfast on the balcony, watched ferries cross the Golden Horn. The apartment is spacious, very pleasant. Very well equipped with furniture, various appliances, cutlery and everyday items.
There is only one AC in the main bedroom. There are windows on the opposite sides of the building, so there was always a draught. I took advantage of this to cool the rest of the rooms in the evening.
The neighbourhood is not too noisy apart from the Mosque nearby - the prayers are loud. The building is on top of a steep hill. This is partly compensated by a bunch of shops right on the same corner.
I used the Internet extensively, it was stable.
The host was very responsive, offered help and advice.
Overall I would say this place is a gem!

Perfect stay, place is spacious and clean. Location is Great and near many attractions and cafes. Our host is very kind and supporting and always available when we needed him. Highly recommended. thank you very much and hope to see you next visit. All the best.

description:
Located in Sisli, Istanbul, our apartments are designed to meet all your needs for a comfortable and peaceful stay. It offers the comfort of your home with its family-friendly environment. Our staff on duty is at your service between 10:00 and 22:00. The entire building has 24 hour active security system and cameras for your safety. A comfortable stay in our apartments with great views of the city.

*Note: If the dates you are looking for are not available, please message us :)

reviews.text: Aparment is very big, comfortable, quiet and in a perfect location. it is very close to markets, pharmacies, shopping stores and subway. Alper was very helpful and kind. He made us feel like at home. In my next trip to Istanbul I will definetly visit his place again.

I had tried many AirBnbs in my life and this is my worst experience ever!
First of all, I checked in and there was a broken bed and they tried to hide it without mentioning it! It seems they may want to blame me for it if I didn’t notice.
The water bidet wasn’t working, they sent “maintenance guy” , it worked for 15 minutes and again , there were many hoses in it which cause a mess!
There is a stain in the main bedroom and the water heater didn’t work. I called the contact person and he replied 5 hours later that it wasn’t switched on and it didn’t work.
The ironing board is broken and finally, one of the chairs is shaking and I couldn’t sit on it.
STAY AWAY !

We enjoying staying here,in Sisli area there are many shops,cafe,restaurant,grocery shoppings. We stayed here for one week,the host always helped us whener we had a problem.
They have cleaning service every 3days, so you will have fresh and clean house during your stay. I recommend if you like lively Istanbul area with full of furnitured place to stay.

The apartment was clean and spacious. It’s rare to find a place that is so well taken care of and with excellent service. The location was great close to supermarket, the mall, restaurants and cafes, and let’s not forget shopping. The manager was available for recommendations and answered questions within the hour.
They also did a thorough cleaning mid week, that was great.

Idrees is very helpful and always available to help within short notice. The apartment is perfectly located at the heart of Şişli; restaurants, shops and groceries are all around. It is also family and kids friendly. We very much enjoyed our stay.

description: Heart of Istanbul. Your elegant chic house in Galata

reviews.text:
The apartment was cosy and well located, just a few steps from Galata tower.
It truly felt like being a local and at a very good price!There was some instant coffee and salted snacks, so you don’t feel the need to buy everything the first day.
The host was quick to provide a few essentials when we ran out (shampoos, toilet paper etc)
and left it at the door.
We were a group of three, one sleeping in the very comfortable sofabed in the kitchen (a little stain on the sheets, but they looked clean so we didn’t say anything about it).
Our double bed in the room was very comfortable, clean and warm.
The room itself had everything you may need and more (racks to dry clothes).
The bathroom is very small and the shower doors could use a little maintenance (we’ve seen way worse in Istanbul), but the shower was actually amazing! Hot, great pressure and clean.
A piece of advice for the third guest on the sofabed: switch the water heater off at night, can be noisy.

Clean and cozy place in the heart of the city.
Apartment located on the second floor and I would not say that it’s noisy (at least during covid pandemic time).
WiFi speed is around 15 mbps, place is good for remote work.
Heating works great so place is suitable for cold season too.
Bathroom is tiny but very clean.
I suggest to communicate your check in plan in advance because by default you will be met near Galata tower.
Overall amazing price/value offer

Very nice host. Disponible at any Time and very helpful and kind.
Nice location, clean and conform to the photos.

Great place! And such a perfect location! It was a shame not to be welcomed by Nuri personally (his friend could barely speak English so we could not ask any questions when we arrived) but we briefly met him when we left and he seemed really nice and hospitable. We would definitely come back, the apartment was comfortable, clean and quiet enough. This neighborhood is perfect, 2 minute walk from Galata Tower, so close to Şişhane metro station (one station away from Taksim where the bus for the airport is) and a 5 minute walk to Karakoy tram station and ferry to easily visit the city (or walk 35-45 minutes to visit main mosques/attractions). Enjoy!

Excellent location, exactly in the pictures as described. Hosts were responsive and met us to check in! Bed bigger than we thought and was comfortable! Was in a safe location and was quiet at night. Would return again!

description:
One of the oldest apartments in Kadikoy ([URL REDACTED] in historical building 1 (saloon / salamanje) + 1 (bedroom) flat
You can view from small balcony one of the most beautiful street in kadıköy.
Every point of the house offers a comfortable living area with its peaceful atmosphere restored in its original form.
Netflix, blutv, puhu tv and youtube, you can watch 4K quality from TV.

reviews.text:
Our review is very subjective. There were 4 of us when we stayed in this apartment for 10 days. We’ve been traveling for a long time and we have 1.5 suitcases. I’m sure we could have a more pleasant experience if there were 2 of us. Because the apartment is comfortable only for 2. Or maybe it would be comfortable for 4 backpackers for brief stays (1-2 days).
Pros:
* It’s a quite nice area. Easy to go to ferries, airport shuttles. There are a lot of cafes, restaurants, supermarkets.
* There is a very well-equipped kitchen: a lot of tableware, an oven, etc.
* During the stay, you can easily communicate with Banu. She helped with water, etc.
Cons:
* There was a quite strong smell in the restroom.
* There is a lot of stuff of the host (really a lot). Only in the bedroom you can store your clothes and personal items. If you rent for 4 people, there aren’t places to store clothes and personal items for the other 2, who live in the guestroom. So we needed to move some items of the host to free a bit of space for us. And we hurried to pack our stuff before checkout, and couldn’t return moved items. This caused a bit of a conflict in chatting after check out. In the kitchen, you may use only part of a refrigerator (small part). There are 3 rooms but you can comfortably use only 2 of them.
* We’ve read reviews about this apartment and almost everyone wrote that it’s clear, but we have not noticed that. Because of a lot of personal stuff of the host in the apartment, it’s quite dusty, so we had to clean it after check-in.
* We always do easy cleaning before leaving, so we’ve never got any complaints about it for all our trips (8 years, almost 30 countries). We’ve vacuumed here, wipe off the dust, etc. But after check out, we’ve got complaints we didn’t make good cleaning.

Banu is an excellent host, I felt like I'm in a friend's home. Her place is not only stylish and calm, but also sparkling clean and comfortable. If you don't want to go outside, you can easily spend time at home. Kitchen is very suitable for cooking. The street is very lively but not noisy. I strongly recommend this place to everyone who like to see a personal touch in every little corner and stay in a living place.

Very central but quiet part of Kadıköy. The businesses in crawling distance are really amazing. The apartment is not very spacious but two people can make it work. Netflix and WiFi worked well and there are all the tools in the kitchen you need. Through Banu (thank you!) it was possible to arrange drinking water delivery, which was really awesome
Great stay and host, very responsive. The location was also great and a very easy walk to several cafes, shops, etc. We would stay again.
Staying at Banus’s place was fantastic: the apartment is great, neighborhood is awesome, and Bantu was a super host and great communicator. We would enthusiastically recommend her place to anyone!

description: Enjoy a spacious, fully equipped studio near Taksim Square at an unbeatable price! Our comfortable studios offer excellent value for money, featuring AC, a washing machine, dryer, private bathroom, and a well-equipped kitchen. Located in the heart of Beyoğlu, with easy access to Istiklal Street, restaurants, shops, metro, buses, and dolmuş. The perfect choice for travelers seeking space, comfort, and a central location without paying high prices.

reviews.text:
Apartment was great, exactly like at the pictures, very clean, cozy and very warm (central heating) which is so important in winter. All amenities included and do work, there is even dryer with washing machine and it’s really helpful.
Location is close to all central landmarks. But neighborhood is calm and quite.
Nael is amazing host! So calm and kind, he helped me with all my questions and did more than above to make my staying comfortable. I felt like I was hosted by an old friend.
Definitely will stay there again!

It was a great airbnb experience. The apartment is accurately described, comfortable, clean, the bed is perfect and you have hot water at anytime. The location is very convenient beacuse is like 20 minutes away from Taksim Square.
During my stay Jalal (the administrator) was very kind and helpful while I had migraine, and during my stay he answered very fast all of my question. I would recommend everybody to stay there👍😁

Just as described, this is a simple cozy room in a nice appartement and walking distance from city sights. The apartment has all the necessities for a few nights for one or two people (bed, fridge, hot shower, kitchen amenities etc.). Communication was on the top level, checking in and out was easy, host is very friendly. I would definitely recommend this room to those seeking a good value place in Istanbul!

Right In the heart of Taksim square. You are in the middle of Istanbul nightlife. Dining. Clubs and markets. You want strawberries at 6am?! They got you. Amazingly walkable to Galata Tower and other historic landmarks. even the Grand Bazaar if you want a real trek it’s far but you can walk! The host was kind and responsive. Very kind. I was there for dental work and couldn’t eat much He was so kind as to buy me a blender! (Remember 6am strawberries!) Place was clean cozy and comfortable. Shower had great pressure with plenty steaming hot water. This place is for the real traveller’s you are in a real Turkish neighbourhood amongst real Turkish people. It should not be any other way.

Great host, helpful with check-in, check-out and other questions, friendly. The location is 20 min by foot from Metro but it's 8-10 min to Taksim square, easy to get there and easy to access it from the center. It is quite safe , during the night there are two shops working 24/7. The place was clean and had everything that was needed. The place matched the description and photos.

reviews.text: One of the best experience on Airbnb. The room was clearly as in the pics. It was extremely clean. The bed was so comfy. Bathroom was clean and in very good condition. The terrace was great. The location is superp. It's 2 minutes to Istqlal street and 2 minutes to Galata tower. Ali was great host. He was very helpful. The check in experience was fantastic and it was around 1 am. Ali put 2 bottles of water in the fridge which helped me a lot as I arrived from the airport very late and couldn't have the energy to go an look for grocery to get water. The only thing to consider is you must climb a stairs as the room is in the 4th floor and it was not an issue for me at all. Many thanks Ali and I hope to stay with you again in the future.

As many former guests already pointed out, Ali's place and the whole handling (check-in, tips for transport etc.) was fantastic!
The flat is small but definitely big enough for 2 people (I stayed there on my own) and has everything you need: a dangerously comfortable bed (I slept VERY well there), a nice clean bathroom, good water pressure and hot water in the shower, good heating, a very clean and big fridge, a closet with hangers, a water cooker for a quick tea or coffee, enough(!) towels, enough outlets (both at the bed and at the table/workspace and a very nice terrace which I didn't use due to the cold weather in December. In summer it must definitely be very nice to sit there with a glass of wine or a beer!
The place is perfectly located within the nice and safe neighborhood of Beyoglu in a very quiet street which is nonetheless super close to the next metro station (Sishane) and the tram station (Tünel) which leaves you right next to the Galata bridge and provides you with transport to Sultanahmet, the piers and all the major sights. The neighborhood has many shops for musical instruments, souvenirs and good food as well...
Ali was a very nice host and the communication could not have been any better. Just ask him anything, he will deliver ;)
Self check-in is possible and worked fine!
For transport from the IST airport get a Istanbulcard, take the Havaist bus (18 lira) to Taksim square from where you can either walk or take the metro to Sishane station.
My favorite tip: take a ferry to Kadiköy (only 3 lira) just before sunset and enjoy the ride to the asian side and then enjoy some of the good food they offer there, plus there will not be many fellow tourists...
So, 5/5 would book again, I'll not waste time looking for anything else the next time I'm around!
János

Nice place near Galata tower.
1. Good place near Galata tower. So many historical objects would be in your comfort walking radius.
2. Near Galata there is noise, craziness, a lot of people. But near this place its really quite.
3. Nice terrace.
4. A lot of cozy places nearby to have great breakfast of good cup of coffee in the evening.
5. Transport is nearby.
6. Ali is really friendly host.
But also there are things you should know.
1. To get to you room you should pass stairs. So be ready to go upstairs 4 levels.
2. Try to close the shower cabin door well. Or you will face little lake in your bathroom.

First, I’d like to say that Ali answer our questions very fast. It was a last minute book and he helped me a lot. The location is perfect! You won’t regret it at all. Everything was clean, the end is very comfortable and the room with terrace is amazing. The hot water was amazing!
Only one thing: if you have a heavy baggage like me, be prepared to go upstairs lol. I took off all the heavy things and went up and down twice. ;)
100% recommended, I’d comeback for sure!
Gayet güzel hoş bir yer. Baktığınızla karşılaştığınız birebir aynı ve temiz. Fiyat performans açısından sizi üzmez. Konum güzel. Ev sahibi kibar ve hızlı dönüş yapıyor. Tavsiye ederim.

So u can book it even in January and be happy)) Ali was very helpful! So for sure I’ll recommend this apart hotel to all my friends. its a very very very perfect location with everything around you, galata tower, istklal Street, metro 5 minutes away, taksim 30 min walking through istiklal Street, definitely i recommend everyone for this airbnb, for the room its quiet area with a cleaned bed sheets and towels, overview i give 5/5 you just need to sleep and take a shower, i will rebook at alis airbnb next time if i want to come back (good price, perfect location, cleaned )

The room is clean and comfortable,with kitchen and laundry machine and heating system. It is located right at the end of Istiklal Street,manychoice for breakfast,meals and grocery stores...Ali is helpful

I had a wonderful stay at Ali’s place. The location is central and convenient, yet the apartment is on a quiet street (great for sleeping). The studio was just as in the pictures: clean, spacious and all basic appliances included. Wifi and AC worked well. Ali was a very responsive host, and as an extra plus he offered covid testing in the apartment before my return flight. The balcony doesn’t have a view, but I didn’t mind - it was still nice to be able to open the door and step out. Five stars all in all!

Fiyat/performans olarak gerçekten çok güzel bir yerde kaldığımı söyleyebilirim. Genel olarak küçük bir yer olmasına karşın sessiz sakin ve hoş bir konaklamamız oldu. Galata’ya bir sokak mesafe gibi böylesi bir konumda bu hizmet bence gayet tatmin ediciydi.

description:
The house is a three-bedroom apartment in a brand new building in Aynalı Cesme, Beyoglu.
There is a fully equipped kitchen, iron, hair dryer, dish-washer and a washing machine for the guests use
The duplex is, less than 10 minutes walk, to istiklal street, which is one of the main shopping and entertaining areas in Istanbul.

It also takes around 15-20 minutes to get to Karakoy and Golden Horn and 30 minutes to the Historical Peninsula by walk.

reviews.text:
Ömer’s place was amazing, just what we were looking for as family of 5.
Great location,
Short walk to Istiklal street and Taksim square.
Lots of restaurants and bars nearby.
The two story apartment was great with 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, two living rooms and 2 kitchens.
It was one bedroom, one bathroom, kitchen,living room and balcony upstairs and
2 bedrooms, one bath, kitchen, living room and balcony downstairs
Great city views from the balconies.
Kitchen was fully equipped with everything you might need.
Lots of towels, toilet paper, shampoo, soap, etc.
Water pressure in the showers was super.
Modern furniture and enough TV channels.
Overall great place for families and a super host we all loved it.
Thanks for everything and definitely will be visiting again.

We spent a week at the apartment. It was spacious and I liked that it wasn't located in the very centre, which meant we could retreat from all the noise and chaos of Istanbul. It's close to a main street and when you walk there you get an amazing view of Istanbul. The place has good amenities and the view from the upstairs balcony is incredible! I was with two women who both felt they wouldn't feel so comfortable walking around alone in our neighborhood at night, which is very personal and subjective but feel it's necessary to mention. In the end we made friends with the man who runs a small convenience store at the end of our street who was very friendly and helpful. My bed was a bit broken and kept on creaking with every movement. Also the upstairs shower door doesn't close properly. All in all it was a good experience staying at Omer's place, the issues I brought up weren't a big deal, however it would have been nice to know about them beforehand. All in all a positive experience.

Lovely apartment with two floors, two living areas and TWO kitchens. The balconies upstairs were lovely. Would have liked a little seating area for morning coffee, but it was enchanting regardless. Very comfortable overall. Lots of room for five. Be warned the hill approaching the building is very steep and you will need to climb three flights of stairs, so not for anyone with mobility issues. Otherwise it is so worth the extra exercise.
Also note, Ubers were very easy for us as we just walked down to the corner for pick-ups. There is a small market at the top of the hill for good for water and snacks.
Highly recommend

This place is ideal for a longer term stay. I booked it for a whole month to reunite with my family from Australia and it didn’t disappoint. I was after a spacious comfy and homey place in winter and this was exactly it.
I had a really pleasant experience from start to finish, very easy checkin/out, Ömer helped us with luggages up and down the stairs. The apartment is fully equipped and if there’s anything extra you need (including cleaning services) Ömer will go above and beyond and arranges it in no time. For example, my parents wanted a Satellite TV and Ömer installed it for them the next day!
There were so many positive aspects but those that stood out were:
-Location is super central yet perfectly tucked away from the busy noisy streets of Beyoglu. Commute to all over Istanbul was very easy and could walk to most local cafes, restaurants, and historical landmarks.
- We received such a warm welcome not just from our host but also our locals who made us feel at home. 10/10 stay

I would recommend the place.
Generally its good, spacious, clean.
Omer was clear with instructions and explained everything before we checked in.
The location is not the best, pretty far from transport, but it it was not a surprise, since everything was described beforehand. I believe price is already aligned with the cons.

description:
In central Istanbul, near Taksim Square. Newly Refurbished Ultra Luxury one bedroom flat which sleeps two people. The apartment is located on the 4th floor..
1 Bathroom+1 Toilet, Fully fitted Kitchen, 55" TV, Internet.
Building has a 24/7 security.
Swimming pool, Sauna, Gym available within the building.
Very close to the underground, buses and other public amenities.
New Istanbul Airport is only 45 minutes away.
Airport Bus (Airbus) transfer services is only 5 minutes walk from our building.

reviews.text:
Great apartment walking distance from Taksim and other touristy areas. We liked the market and cafe right outside the lobby, which were convenient for finding bottled water and getting a latte, cappuccino, or Turkish coffee every morning.
The bed was comfortable, and particularly nice to have A/C in both the bedroom and the main living area.
Reception was very friendly and spoke good enough English to help with basic needs like calling a taxi for us when needed. Serkan was also very helpful, he was the one who gave us the key and welcomed us on day one (and received the key from us at the end as well). He even offered to call us to talk to our taxi driver to make sure we were arriving to the right place, which was excellent because the taxis rarely spoke any English.
Overall we were quite happy with this choice! The pictures are exactly what you get.

Alem's place was exactly as described. It is a 8 minute walk from a major bus stop to take you anywhere. There are a couple restaurants across the street and a supermarket. Easily located for food delivery services. Her assistant was very responsive. I recommend!

Great place to stay, nice decoration very secure, clean, well designed just like the pictures.
Taksim is 5 min away by car (parking inside the residence) and 11 min by walk.
A big thanks to Alem and Serkan who were there for us all the time and helped us a lot during our stay.

This was a perfect place for a first visit to Istanbul. The apartment itself is very comfortable and has nearly all of the modern amenities one could ask for and is located at a walking distance (~ 10 mn) from Taksim square, Istiklal avenue, Metro and funicular station.
The host was very friendly and managed to be there late evening for check-in and early morning for check out.
I 100 % recommend this place.

We loved Alem's place. The apartment was exactly as described, close to the center of town and very comfortable. We had great communication prior to arriving and we were met at the apartment. I would defiently recommend if you are visiting Istanbul.

description:
Blue apartments located at perfect point that only one minute from Taxim Square. Location is center of Istanbul and it is compeletly safe and clean.
The Apartments renoveted and have all things that you need for personel comfort.
Managed by professionels like a hotel but you feel like at home.

reviews.text: Choose this place only if you have absolutely no other option. The photos on the listing do not match the apartment you get, as the host uses the same pictures for all units. The real place is tiny, damp, and has visible mold. The size is not indicated and should be, because even one person with a suitcase can barely move. The bathroom is essentially a closet and if you are taller than 155 cm the toilet is almost unusable. Only one roll of toilet paper was provided for a week, and when I asked for more I was told to buy it myself. On the third day the power went out; I came back soaked from the rain and could not dry myself, shower, or use heating. Nearby shops used diesel generators and the smell of gasoline filled the apartment. I had to leave immediately, and the steep, dangerous stairs made carrying luggage down in total darkness genuinely risky. Some places should honestly not be allowed to operate.

Check in is postponed until 4:30 pm - 5:00pm because the studio is not ready and not clean.
Very narrow stairs so dangerous to step on to arrive to the first floor where you can find the mini elevator, imagine yourself carrying a suitcase 🧳 on these dangerous stairs.
Too much etching when using the bed until they gave a new bedsheet
Cockroach 🪳 are everywhere
Smelly toilet all day
All kitchen equipments are damaged and out of days and dirty or broken , only the Air-conditioning and the fridge are ok with a lot of small alive cockroaches 🪳 inside the fridge.
Too much Meo Meo from the neighbors every night 👀 🔥
Location is perfect 👍🏻 just few steps to taksim square and all transportations

The value for price of this place exceeds all its cons. It is very cheap and surprisingly clean as well, I have been to many hotels within Istanbul and this Airbnb is really clean.
The studio we got was spacious and fully equipped with everything, we did not feel that anything was missing.
There was a problem with checking-in but the owners were professional in handeling it.
Be careful if you have heavy stuff as the first floor does not have an elevator.
If you are a light sleeper I do not suggest this place as it is located in a very busy area.
We felt safe as well, although the area did not seem that safe yet the studio itself is very well protected and you can find police officers all around the place.
Very good location with great value, hosts are very fast responding
It was fine no problems and cheap place, however you might hear upstairs neighbors clapping cheeks and smell them smoking

description:
Explore Istanbul’s most vibrant neighborhoods with this comfortable, self-contained room as your base. The apartment has everything to make you feel at home – WiFi, Netflix, washer and dryer, queen size bed, well equipped kitchen and tableware

You’ll be close to everything in Istanbul but far enough to enjoy a relaxing trip.

reviews.text: The accomodation was like what I expected^^ Fatıma is friendly and helpful. She was a wonderful host. She was so kind and welcoming. I totally recommend her house^^It is so clean and cute. I love it..It has got a perfect balcony and comfortable bed:) As described, in a very good location and well priced. Btw her cat is sooooooo cute ♡ I miss it already :( I want to thank her for her hospitality♡

I totally recommend Fatima's place: the location is perfect (close to ferries, buses, taxis, mini-bus ) but also a 5 min walk to the cost. The street is full of cute cafes and restaurants if you wanna grab a book and enjoy Istanbul's weather. The flat is super clean and quiet, comfortable bed, everything you need. Fatima was very quick to answer my questions, smiling, responsive and polite. RECOMMENDED

Fatima's was a great host. She is communicative and delightful, she respond very quickly and made the whole process super easy! Fatima's place is perfect for a stay in Kadikoy (asian side of Istanbul). The location was great. It’s a short walk to the metro station or ferry but it’s also very central.
To be honest I️ rarely used public transportation because it was always convenient to just walk but when I️ needed to it was right there.
There’s lots of restaurants and life around but in the flat itself it’s completely quiet.
Fatima’s place is very clean and comfortable and has everything you could need. I️ would 100% recommend a stay here.

Very nice room and flat! Got all I needed and very nice interior and balcony
The location is amazing, have everything really close and a lot of nice cafes!
Host Fatima is really friendly and helpful! Want to say thank you!
And the cat is a star really :)

Fatima is a very nice and polite woman, her house is really clean, nicely decorated and in the city center. She has been a very helpful host
İ would definitely recommend her.

description: It is far from Istanbul's tourist attractions. It is close to public transportation. You can get to many places by train by going to Küçükçekmece Marmaray Station with the minibus that passes by the street. You can reach the Metrobus in 15 minutes on foot. Metrobus is the most common public transportation vehicle used in Istanbul. You can get to many points in Istanbul with this vehicle. My house is located close to Avcılar Center.

reviews.text: The flat is comfortable, spacious and pretty clean. Rahsan was very helpful and kind. There are some little flaws, but Rahsan can make everything to fix it. The flat is rather far from the centre of Istanbul, but you can easily find the public transport stops nearby.

Rahsan's place was very cozy and clean. Rahsan is an excellent host and was very kind and helpful. I highly recommend Rahsan and her apartment if you need to stay in Avcilar. It is a bit of a walk to the center, but staying in her place is really worth it!!

This place is a very nice and comfortable apartment on 3rd floor of a residential building. It is located a bit far from all touristy places but on the other hand it is a nice and quiet neighbourhood. You can find some small fresh food markets and local groceries stores nearby. reviews.text: The greatest thing about the place is it's location, it's in a walkable distance from a lot of things in the center. The bedroom is surrounded by windows from 3 sides that have courtains. Also the hair dryer in the bathroom doesn't work sometimes. WiFi is pretty bad in the sense that it often breaks up. The biggest problem with the place is that for the most of the time we didn't have warm water in the shower. All in all an ok place to stay for a shorter period of time if you don't mind a cold shower.

Great location with very friendly hosts and a nice restaurant just downstairs. This is a relatively new Airbnb and as such the owners are still working out the kinks. Instead of a fitted sheet for the mattress, the bed had only a flat sheet that was a bit too small for it so it would constantly come off the bed. For a few days I had only a hand towel because the bath towels were getting laundered. But the hosts were very kind and accommodating and did their best to address the issues they could address. And I believe they're continuing to work on this apartment, including replacing the AC with a newer model. This place will work for you if all you need is a simple and basic place that's affordable and in a great location.

And it would have been good to be informed prior that the payment for the airport pick up needed to be in cash. I should have asked, but I felt the host was very persistant about the cash payment and I would have preferred to pay by credit card. Not a big deal but just something to note. Still had a wonderful stay here and the location was excellent and very safe!

We stayed in Yuksel’s place for 10 days and it was an extremely pleasant experience. Yuksel is an intelligent, kind and very organized host! He truly cares about his guests and goes above and beyond for them. We were 4 girls traveling to a new country and he made us feel comfortable and safe. As well, anytime we needed anything or if something was not working properly he would be at our door step within minutes to solve our problem. Cansu, the host is very nice, responds very fast, texted me every morning to check if i ever needed or was missing out on anything.. Also helped me out with few questions around the area
The location - Ortokay is very central to everything, close to the bosphorus, busy in the weekends with a nice vibe - a mix between locals & tourists so you won’t feel like a stranger, if you have your windows closed it is almost very quiet inside
I stayed for 5 nights & took a tour around Istanbul using bus, metros, fairy & taxis & did not hesitate that i chose the best the location. only unless you are a big fan of everyday Shopping around Taksim & Sisli, I would recommend you stay around Beyoglu.
Thanks Cansu for being a top host! 🙏

Cansu‘s Place has everything you need. The location is great and all the amenities are all as described. Tha apartment is in a busy area. However, luckily there is no noise coming from the outside. Although it was clean, I would say there could be still improvements made e.g. glass shower doors. Altogether the experience was good. Cansu is very responsive and tries to be as helpful as possible and her apartment is also in a good condition.
Great place, exactly as described and Cansu is extremely responsive! Nice area too, a bit away from the chaos and a few mins walk from the water. Highly recommend!

Really nice stay! Location is amazing as well! You have to try Elise Karadeniz for food! They are like a few steps away and some of the best food we have ever had! The owner is just so kind and did so much to make our stay comfortable. Thank you!!

Great place to stay for a few nights. a bit smaller than expected but it has everything you need for a short stay. location was probably the best positive but one has to be able to cope with the noise. host was also very accommodating even though his English was limited.

description: This flat is located in Taksim square and is surrounded by 5 star hotels which makes it extremely safe and convenient for families/groups. It’s only 1 minute away from Havaist and Havabus station. The flat is on second floor and there’s no elevator in the apartment.

reviews.text: We enjoyed our staying at Fatih's apartment. Perfect place to stay both for a short and long time. It has a perfect location within a walk away distance from everything. It's practically in the center of Taxim Square. With Metro station and bus stations 5 minutes away. The atmosphere and environment are peaceful, cozy, and relaxing. The whole feeling is like home and what is most important - safe. It is more spacious than it looks on the pictures. Fast wifi. The host and his co-host are very responsive; they are very nice and friendly. Osman helped accommodate us for extra days when we had to extend our staying . He let us have an earlier check-in time. He was quick to respond and even fixed some minor issues we told him about within minutes. Check-in and check-out were super easy. I will definitely stay at his apartment again. I will recommend it to everyone who needs a good centrally-located place at a very good price with super hosts. Thank you.

Osman, our host, was really a very responsive, friendly, and very professional host. He tried to help us from the beginning. He booked for us the transfer from the airport directly to the apartment and vice versa for a reasonable price. During our stay, he contacted us to see if everything was ok. The apartment is just a few meters from Taxim Square, surrounded by many restaurants and on walkable distance to many attractions and ahoping areas. Even if it is in an old building, the apartment is very clean with all necessities you may need during your stay. We had a lovely time in Istanbul, and we definitely recommend Osman and his apartment.

I love it so much! Near EVERYWHERE. Osman did a great job as a host. The place is clean, everything available as the description, there's no something minus from this apartment except we have to carry our luggages on the second floor. But hey, that's worth it for this nice, clean, and comfy place! Thank you so much! I will recommend this place to my closest!

reviews.text: I had a great stay at Emin’s place in Şişli! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is excellent, with easy access to everything in Istanbul. Emin was a wonderful host—very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout my stay. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

I had a really great stay here. The apartment was super clean and comfortable, and the host even offered a cleaning service every 10 days or so, which was such a nice touch. He was always super responsive and willing to help with anything I needed. The location is also great. There’s lots of restaurants and cafes within walking distance, which made things really convenient. Overall, I’d definitely recommend staying here!

This was my second stay in this building, but in a different apartment. This one was much better, newly renovated, cozy, and very comfortable. The apartment has everything you need for a longer stay. The only downside was the slow Wi-Fi, which might be an issue if you plan to work remotely.
I’d also like to give special thanks to the host. Communication was excellent, and they were always responsive, helpful, and genuinely cared about making my stay comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.
We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very responsive and easy to communicate with. Highly recommended!

Muhammed Emin was very helpful, always available for inquiries, the place was clean. He had many flats available you could choose between them. 8 minutes to Mecidiey metro station 15 minutes to cevahir mall.

description: Hello everyone. Our room is in Kadıköy, 1 minute walk from the port. There is music at night as there is a bar under the building. Please be aware of this. Please feel free to ask all your questions and requests. I will be happy to answer.

reviews.text:
about this airbnb, let me break it down
I decided to book it last Minute because I only needed something for one night.
+ good location, easy to find
+ lots of things around
+ the bed was okay
+ the AC worked fine
+ host was always quick to answer me
- the music from the Bar was really loud (I didnt think it would be this bad but until 4-5 in the morning I wasnt able to sleep) so I wouldn't recommend it if you have a light sleep
- the TV didnt work (it had WiFi but something was broken ig?)
- one of the windows was blocked by metal.. that diesnt show in the pictures
- there was a big and bright exit-sign between the windows (which is also not shown in the pictures) it lights up the room day and night and there is no way to turn it off
- there were dirty wet and stained (maybe mold?) towels in the bathroom
Overall the stay could have been worse but i wouldnt come back & I wouldn't recommend this airbnb if you plan on spending some time indoors or stay for more than 3 days.

Birkaç kere gelip kaldığım bir yer, temizliği için tercih ediyorum. Sadece "temiz görünen" bir yer değil. Genelde oteller ve airbnb daireleri temiz görünüşlü oluyor, ancak gerçekten temiz olan bir yer bulmak kolay değil. Burası özellikle tuvalet banyo konusunda gerçekten temiz. Zemin temizliği de aynı şekilde. Müzik problemi var evet ama aşırı bir rahatsızlık duymadım ben, zaten ev sahibi de bu konuyla ilgili gerekli uyarıları yapmış. Genel olarak memnun kaldığım, iyi bir fiyat/performansa sahip bir oda.

Check-in was as described, no issue with flexible check-in. The location is very convenient as advertised and expected. There was no issue with cleanliness, the room is equipped with basic needs and has enough space for luggage etc. Late nights during the weekend were noticeably noisy but it came as no surprise knowing the neighborhood. I had my earplugs taking care of that expected issue :) I needed 15-20 min more time than what is written as latest check-out time and the host was flexible and friendly with this as well.

Ev sahibi sorularima hizli cevaplar vererek cok kisa surede rezervasyon yapip konaklayabilmeme imkan sagladi. Evet biraz ses oluyor, tam sessizlik isteyenler icin uygun degil. Guzel bir konumda, fiyat/performans konaklama icin oldukca uygun. Dus ve banyo gayet iyi. Yatak cok rahatti, oda ferahti. Internet kotu ve tv yayini yok ama benim icin cok onemli olmadigi icin ev sahibine ulasmadim, belki cozumu olan seylerdir. Ozetle ben kendi beklentilerim dogrultusunda faylasiyla memnun kaldim, tesekkurler.

3 minutes walk from Kadıkoy Port.
5 minutes from restaurants and shops. I was traveling alone and found the area very safe, even at night. Impeccable cleanliness.
Very helpful host. I had a small problem in the room and (although not resolved) he did what he could to help. Many have complained about the noise at night.. It's true.
There is a club nearby and music until late, especially on the weekend. Personally it wasn't a problem at all. Maybe because I was exhausted by the kilometers I had walked in Istanbul but I slept very well. I'll be back! Thank you!

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. Our house, located in the hotel area on Tepebaşı Street, 400 m from Istiklal Street, 900 m from Galata Tower, 450 m from Şişhane metro station, offers you a unique day and night view with its front and back balconies. Our apartment is bright, clean, modern and comfortable. Completely renovated and brand new furniture. A private house in the heart of the city, a great accommodation opportunity for you and your family awaits you.

reviews.text:
We were delighted to meet Ilker at the front door when we arrived. Because there is no parking on his street, it was really helpful he was right there. This is a nice building -- the nicest in the area -- and the elevator really helps for a 4th floor apartment.
The apartment is exactly as advertised with three well-furnished and spacious bedrooms, one with a large queen-sized bed and the others with twin beds. Great for a family. The common areas are comfortable and the deck off the living room is a wonderful place to relax and watch the city, or maybe even a football match! We appreciated that it was super clean.
It takes a bit of a walk uphill to get to Istiklal Street (300-400 meters) and Galata Tower, but quite worth the effort to be on a quiet safe street away from the partying crowds.
Many thanks to our host Ilker for making his stylish comfortable apartment available to us, and for his warm hospitality. A memorable stay, highly recommended!

Our first visit to Istanbul and we had a great time, staying for 10 days in April. A comfortable, nicely furnished apartment, very conveniently located. Apartment was spotlessly clean, as in the photos. Pantry has everything needed for cooking - fridge, oven, gas cooker and kitchen utensils. Location is great, for essentials there is a grocery store a few minutes walk from the apartment. You can walk in about 10 minutes to Istiklal street, which has lots of shops, coffee shops, restaurants etc. The Galata Tower is within walking distance and there is easy access to public transport. We caught the tram from Tophane to visit the other side of the Golden Horn and the main historical sights (there is also a metro and bus station nearby). Ilker was very responsive and helpful, checking in on us mid way. All in all it was a great stay, and definitely recommend. We hope to be back someday!

Firstly the location of the apartment is fantastic. A short walk to the main streets and a supermarket close by with a few other shops on the same road. We used public transport to visit most places and main landmarks which were easily accessible with short walks to the stops.
The apartment itself felt like home from home. It was very clean, comfortable and well equipped, especially the kitchen. The hot showers always helped to get the day started 😊. sometimes there is a smell from the bathroom but that is to be expected given the old city.
Ilker was an amazing host ☺️ and happy to answer any questions we had or if we needed anything extra for the apartment.
We were a family of four adults & enjoyed every minute of our time in Istanbul, made better because of the accommodation.
I would definitely recommend the apartment to friends and family. Just a note; the apartment is quite high up but there is an elevator at hand.

It was a wonderful stay. Ilker waited for us, welcomed me and my family on our arrival and he explained us what to benefit from the flat. He thinks of every little detail, we had everything we need in the house. There was more than enough space for 4 of us. House was extremely clean and tidy. The location is perfect. A lot of popular places nearby. The famous Pera Palace hotel is just few steps away.
Rooms are spacious and beds are comfortable. Heating was working nonstop. Kitchen is beautiful and perfect for cooking. The area is very safe. There is a parking lot just in front of the apartment. The host is very friendly and polite. We will come back for sure.
Thank you Ilker! For the unforgettable stay!

Ilker's apartment was a great oasis of calm for our week in busy Istanbul. Although located within a 10-minute walk from busy Istiklal area (full of restaurants, cafes, shops), the apartment is on a quiet street and so our nights were quiet. The apartment was spotlessly clean and very nicely equipped for a comfortable stay, with many essentials provided (washing powder for washing machine, kitchen items, etc). The apartment is on the fourth floor (there is a working lift) and offers nice views in two different directions across the city. We visited in winter (January) and the apartment was very warm. We met Ilker during check-in and he followed up again mid-way through our stay to see if we needed anything. Great communication, great service, highly recommended!

reviews.text: This place is amazing. I made a last minute booking and Hakan was very kind and helpful he let me check in before and he was always responsive. The room is exactly like in the picture it’s very clean and fresh, bed was comfortable and the AC was on when I arrived so the room was super fresh. It’s well equipped with everything you will find, the furniture is new . Turkish tea and cold water inside the fridge, for me this is one of the best places to stay in kadikoy, love it. I’m a solo female traveler and I felt safe. The location is also great close to the ferry, bus station and surrounded of local restaurants, have been in Istanbul multiple times and for me Kadikoy is the best area to stay. Thank you for everything Hakan.

Hakan is very attentive host, and the flat is very clean, very convenient location, perfect for a business trip. I came to Istanbul for a work trip, our event venue was in Levent, but I chose Kadıköy, because it's more beautiful here then in Levent, and there is Metrodus which takes you pretty much everywhere you need in the city. I especially was looking for a place which is both walking distance to Metrobus and is in a good area. This flat is perfect. Also the bed is awesome. Had really good sleep there after intensive work. There is a park nearby, so you can run or make sports there, and it's really close to the pier. Bathroom is very clean, there are supermarkets nearby. Main shopping street is also cloose. Internet is superfast and the instructions Hakan gave were perfect and very easy to follow.

I stayed at Hakan’s for four nights last week. The place looked exactly as the description and the photos. The apartment was tidy and clean and the aircon was very good in keeping the toom cool, as the temperature outside was reaching 32 degrees. Self-check in/out was easy. Hakan was ver responsive and instructions for check in and check out were very clear. Lots of cafes, restaurants and shops in the area. It’s about 2-3 min walk to the Bull statue and also the trum to Moda and Kadikoy Sahil. But you can also walk to the Kadikoy Sahil; it is approx. 15 min walk. Also, bus stop about a min from the property and lots buses which will take you to different parts of Kadikoy. I would definitely recommend Hakan’s place if you want to stay in Kadikoy.

We really enjoyed our stay at the Hakan‘s apartment. It was warm, clean, tidy and stylish, with everything you need inside. It was even more spacious than on pictures. The location was perfect, with plenty of restaurants and cafes around, with supermarket next door. Hakan was there for us all the time ready to help. We had some problems with a kettle, so Hakan replaced it in 10 minutes after our request. Bedding and towels were like at a good hotel. Wi-Fi was perfect. The apartment is quiet, as the windows face the inner yard, so you don’t hear the noise of the street. Thank you Hakan, we will be happy to stay at your place again!

We had a wonderful stay! Hakan was a great host—very welcoming, helpful, and easy to communicate with. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We felt at home throughout our stay and really enjoyed our time here. We would definitely stay again and highly recommend it to others!

reviews.text: Temizlik açısından fotoğraflarla alakası yok 6 kişi yatacak yer vardı ancak yeteri kadar nevresim vb. Yoktu kombi bozuktu.
