description:
Enjoy a wonderful stay in your tiny apartment in this mansion, one of Kadıköy's historic bay window houses.
the flat is all yours. It has been completely renovated, but you can feel the spirit of this historic mansion with its building entrance, stairs and high ceilings. Even if the apartment is small, the high ceilings always give you a spacious feeling. With its vibrant and central location, everything for groceries, transportation, dining and entertainment will be just a 2-3 minute walk away.

reviews.text:
Absolutely incredible!
The place is just like in the photos, perfectly clean. I saw how the cleaning services work, they don’t miss even the tiniest spot.
The flat was really comfortable, walking distance to metro, bus station and the ferries. There are many restaurants and cafes around, many has vegan options too.
Tugba is an excellent host. She was always there for us, always in contact.
Thank you so much for everything, %200 would stay again! ♥️

Tuğba ve Ahmet'in yerlerinden birinde ikinci konaklamam. Daha önceki başka yerdi. Her zaman yardımsever, iletişim konusunda destekçiler. Mekânlarının her biri geniş fiyat skalasında ve fiyatına göre uygun koşullara sahip oluyor. Bu sefer daha uygun bir yere ihtiyacım vardı, ona göre bir yerle karşılaştım.
Burası neredeyse tek kişilik. İki kişiyseniz de aynı yerde yatacağınızı, bunun açılmış bir çekyat olduğunu unutmayın. Yani bence 2-3 geceden uzun iki kişilik konaklamalar için başka alternatiflere bakılabilir. Ben yalnız kaldım, özellikle sabahları arka bahçeye bakan balkonda kahve içip yazmak çok keyifliydi.
Evde imkânlar ve malzemelerde hijyen vardı ama bina eski ve yıpranmış yerler de var. Benim için önemsiz ama dert edenler için not düştüm.
Muhit çok merkezi, çarşıya, rıhtıma çok yakın. Yakında bir türkü bar var. Normalde de tıkaçla uyuduğum için çok rahatsız etmedi.
Sonraki seyahatlerde de ilk bakacağım seçenekler Tuğba ve Ahmet'in olacak.

With my fiancé we think this place is our escape place. We love this place. We wanna go back there again. We love the balcony and the cats that stop by. It is literally walk distance to many restaurants. It is also very close to ferry station to go to European side, around 8-10 mins to walk. And the host is reachable and helpful. Water pressure is also good in the shower. I just love this place a lot. Even if it was cold when we stayed this time, we didnt feel cold there. Heating is also good. I highly recommend this.

The host is really responsive and the location of the apartment is just perfect.
I recommend bringing ear plugs if you are a light sleeper as the walls are very thin.
The photos must have been taken just after the place was renovated as it does not look that spotless anymore but that didn't really bother me that much. Overall I would say there is everything you need in the apartment and I enjoyed staying there.
hosts were very responsive and helpful and the location is very good however unfortunately there is so much noise outside and inside the building (upstairs etc) sleeping properly is not possible

description:
Wake up in this three story townhouse located at at the heart of Beyoglu .The newly renovated space is meticulously built for travelers who look for a touch of good design.

SUHU HOMES

reviews.text:
Upon arrival there was graffiti on outside wall very unsightly! Over powering smell from cat faeces and urine in the plantar boxes on front veranda we had to clean the area ourselves, had them removed upon request not a good first impression!
Internally curtain rod broken hanging in the middle big crack in wall near front door, downstairs toilet did not work we only booked accommodation knowing that there was a second toilet! Damp musty smell in living area and in the TV room in lower level was very stuffy and musty smell, also we had to buy scented candles to hide smell not impressed!! No mattress protectors on the beds, handles on kitchen cupboards all loose I had tightened them myself. Su was aware of all these problems they should have been resolved before we arrived considering the amount we paid for the accommodation.
Not worth the money!!!

Su’s little house is great
Pros are Looks exactly like the photos, A/C in both bedrooms located on the second floor, and on the first floor, where the kitchen and the half bath is located. Very comfortable beds. Great hot water and pressure. Basement has a great little living room. flexible, check-in, which we really appreciated.
Cons: and this is only my personal opinion is even though the house is located on a side street. There is a a lot of traffic that cuts through the street. So if you are a light sleeper, this is going to be an issue. If you are not this place is perfect The house is small, but it was great for the two of us. (even for four people). It still is a good space. The only other con is the half bath toilet has a mind of its own and decides when it wants to flush and when it doesn’t. Having said that I still would definitely recommend this little house. It’s in a great neighborhood with shops and restaurants within walking distance. You will love it!

The house is beautifully decorated and has a cozy atmosphere. However, we found it smaller than it appeared in the pictures, and unfortunately, the hygiene and cleaning standards did not meet our expectations, especially for Turkish standards. The lack of an aeration system in the bathroom and the toilets on the first floor caused significant humidity issues, leading to an unpleasant smell throughout the house. Despite regularly opening windows for fresh air, the house became uncomfortably cold due to the absence of sufficient radiators.
The basement is a lovely space with a big TV, but the lack of heating made it too cold to enjoy for more than an hour. We relied heavily on the AC units in the bedrooms to stay warm, but they were noisy and made sleeping uncomfortable.
Considering that we booked this home to spend quality time indoors during Christmas, the overall experience did not match the price we paid. We hope these issues can be addressed to improve the experience for future.

I stayed at Su’s place with my parents for nearly two weeks and couldn’t have asked for more. The house was fantastic – modern, well-equipped, clean, and very comfortable. The location is ideal, with plenty of restaurants and quirky shops nearby, and all the must-see sights are easily accessible by tram. Su was incredibly responsive, even to urgent requests, like when I accidentally locked the door with the key inside – she had it resolved in no time. I highly recommend both the accommodation and Su as a host. Thank you so much, Su!

Great location, and the host was extremely helpful when looking for a pharmacy open on a Sunday, even calling places to confirm. Check in and out were effortless. The place itself was exactly what we needed, clean, comfortable, and cute.

description: This suite has a private kitchenette and a private bathroom with jacuzzi. There is 24 hours door man and there is cleaning service once every 2 days. The complex has private Turkish bath, sauna and fitness room. The turkish bath and sauna is private and need to be booked upon arrival for free entrance. There is a shared sea view roof terrace.

reviews.text:
+ We were welcomed really warmly by receptionists downstairs, it is nice to hear "welcome back" every time we return to the room. A really heartwarming goodbye too. Guys were also ready to give recommendations about good places to eat or to go.
+ The place is close to the sea (10 minutes walking) and to other historical places, you can do a really nice walking tour from the apartment without taking public transport.
+ The room is equipped with all utensils you need for cooking (pans, plates, knives, wine glasses, corkscrew etc.)
+ Jacuzzi was a great experience
- The room was way smaller in real life than on the photos, many small details showed that the room is a little old (peeling paint around the window, not properly working door to the bathroom, power sockets were old and weak).
- Most of the time by cleaning we were provided with old bad looking towels. There were no refills of shower gel and soap (we stayed there 1 week). There was no shampoo.
Overall, the stay was great, we are thankful to everyone who contributed in it!

We spent 11 days in this mini hotel. Room was very cozy, clean, good equipped and really it felt nice. Must say that kitchen amenities are very good and are making it really fully functional and we easily were able to cook anything.
Erol and Yusuf are polite, friendly, offering advises and local tips and any kind of help. Cleaning ladies i must mention too, always smiling and regularly coming to clean the room or check if we need anything.
There is also sauna available for guests and its very nice.
Location is really very good and central in Sultanahmet. There are 2 big grocery stores around, fast food, restaurants, all kind of small shops....
Tram station which connects all Sultanahmet and further offer connections to other transport is also very close. Anyway we didnt need to use taxi at all, as with tram we could reach metro or buses and reach any part of Istanbul easy and fast.
But from here exploring Sultanahmet was easy even by foot as in about 1km you can already see Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapi Palace etc. Really good area.
The only problem we had was very acoustic rooftop which should be nice to sit and have a view, but 2 nights in a row very loud guests were gathering there and being so loud that we had such noise like they are making party in our room and we couldn't sleep at all until 4 in the morning. Complaint on reception in the morning after first night didnt help, as they repeated the same already the next night so we had to complain again. Noise from rooftop which is open to stairs can be heard even 3 floors down extremely loud. After 2nd complaint all was calm and quiet next days and as apology hosts organised free transport to airport.

For the price of what you pay, this place is fine. Having someone on the door all the time is helpful when arriving at 1:30am like we did.
The rooms are okay, they are not made on a daily basis for you and do not exactly have the most comfortable beds but they work.
The "Jacuzzi" would be lucky to fit a small child in it so was unused and the shower is either burn or freeze.
In all though, a rather nice place within walking distance to the bazzar and all the sights and excellent value.

Yusuf’s hotel is really amazing, and looks just like the photos. I really loved my room, and I stayed for 10 nights and felt right at home. I didn’t get to meet Yusuf himself, but he had 3 staff members there (3 men) who were all very friendly, helpful, and gave great advice on the things to do in Istanbul and how to get around. They offer you coffee and tea every time you leave and come back, and we’re so hospitable. I was coming back really late at night each night and there was always someone at the door, and it was not a problem. The hotel is about a 7min walk to the metro, so it is very easy and convenient to get around, the only thing is you have to walk quite a bit uphill to get there. The room itself was super comfortable and I felt right at home, just the walls are thin, so if you have loud neighbors, you will be able to hear them. The bed was comfortable for me, it is on the firmer side, but I liked it. The hotel is in Sultanahmet, which is the historical side, it is a great place to stay to be super close walking distance to hagia Sofia, blue mosque, topkapi palace, and bascillica Cistern. I would highly recommend staying here if you can, especially if you are traveling alone and would need some extra guidance during your stay. Uber is also very cheap in Istanbul so it’s easy to get around if you want to stay out late in Taksim, Kadikoy, etc. Thanks for much to Yusuf and his staff for their hospitality! :)

Yusuf's hotel was absolutely amazing. It was one of the best places we stayed during our two weeks in Turkey. The room was newly renovated, and absolutely beautiful. The little kitchenette in the room was perfect, the bedroom had plenty of room, and the marble bathroom was pretty upscale. Loved the overall industrial/steampunk motif. The private hammam in the basement was a really nice touch, and a great way to have a little Turkish bath experience before diving into the real thing. Yusuf and his staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and always happy to offer advice and a cup of tea or coffee with a cookie, no matter the time of the day. The location of the hotel was fabulous - easy walking distance to everything, and the street was relatively quiet as far as Istanbul goes. Wifi was great throughout the hotel, and the rooftop terrace had a nice view of the sea and plenty of places to relax and have a drink. Because the renovations are so new, they were still working out a few kinks during our visit: they were still installing lights in our room, for instance, and some of the furniture was a bit stiff and had a bit of a chemical smell - but it was nothing inconvenient. It was truly amazing, and I will absolutely contact Yusuf the next time we travel to Istanbul. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text:
Cityloft was conveniently located for us to stay near relatives and served our purpose well. The bed was comfortable, the shower had good water pressure and temperature, the amenities all worked. Staff were all friendly and helpful.
However, I wouldn't recommend a friend to stay here. The room was dusty and had stains on the walls, carpet and furniture. The curtains and bed linen had holes in. The room frequently smelled of stale cigarette smoke (we don't smoke). Our room card stopped working every 2 days. Some maintenance and upgrades to the furniture would have made our stay very enjoyable as the staff were kind and everything else was fine.

Otel merkezi bir yerin sessiz bir bölgesinde, rahatsız olmayacağınız bir konumda ve her şey kaliteli bir otel standardında. Odanın temizlenmesi ile ilgili bir şey belirtmediğimiz halde housekeeping'in odada bulunduğumuz esnada kapıyı açması biraz korkuttu.
Uzun süreli konaklamalara sanırım hiçbir otel veya ev sahibi hazır olmuyor. Odanın içine en azından yüzeysel de olsa toz alacağım bir süpürge koyulması iyi olurdu.

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with my recent stay at city loft .
Firstly, the photos on the listing were misleading. The actual condition of the room was significantly different and seemed to reflect its state when it was first built, not its current state.
Secondly, the walls were incredibly thin, and for two nights, I was unable to sleep due to the noise from the neighboring rooms.
Lastly, the air conditioning was controlled by the main office. Despite calling maintenance three times, the issue was not resolved. The AC turned on automatically in the middle of the night, even after I was assured this wouldn’t happen. This made the room unbearably cold and disrupted my sleep further.
Overall, my stay was extremely uncomfortable and far from the experience I expected.
could not sleep for two nights
